# dropbox

## DROPBOX_ACTIVATE_TEAM_FOLDER
Tool to activate an archived team folder. Use when you need to restore access to a previously archived team folder.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ActivateTeamFolderRequest",
  "required": [
    "team_folder_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "team_folder_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Team Folder Id",
      "examples": [
        "13747111155",
        "84528192421"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the team folder to activate."
    }
  }
}
```

## DROPBOX_ADD_FILE_MEMBER
Tool to add specified members to a Dropbox file with configurable access levels. Use when sharing a file with specific users by email or Dropbox ID. Supports custom invitation messages and notification controls. Note: This endpoint does not support apps with the app folder permission, and members will receive invitations unless quiet mode is enabled.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "AddFileMemberRequest",
  "required": [
    "file",
    "members"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "file": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "File",
      "examples": [
        "id:7bh4zBmgZoAAAAAAAAABCQ",
        "/Documents/report.pdf"
      ],
      "description": "File to which to add members. Use the file ID format (e.g., 'id:7bh4zBmgZoAAAAAAAAABCQ') or file path."
    },
    "quiet": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Quiet",
      "default": false,
      "description": "Whether to suppress device notifications for added members. If false (default), members will be notified of their invitation."
    },
    "members": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "MemberSelector",
        "required": [
          ".tag"
        ],
        "properties": {
          ".tag": {
            "enum": [
              "email",
              "dropbox_id"
            ],
            "type": "string",
            "title": ".Tag",
            "description": "Type of member selector. 'email' - Add member by email address. 'dropbox_id' - Add member by Dropbox account ID."
          },
          "email": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Email",
            "examples": [
              "testuser@example.com",
              "colleague@company.com"
            ],
            "description": "Email address of the member to add. Required when tag is 'email'. Note: If the email is the user's main account email, they may be directly added to the membership."
          },
          "dropbox_id": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Dropbox Id",
            "examples": [
              "dbid:AAH4f99T0taONIb-OurWxbNQ6ywGRopQngc"
            ],
            "description": "Dropbox account, team member, or group ID. Required when tag is 'dropbox_id'."
          }
        },
        "description": "Identifies a member to add to the file."
      },
      "title": "Members",
      "minItems": 1,
      "description": "List of members to add to the file. Each member is identified by email or Dropbox ID. Note: If an email is provided and it's the user's main account email, they may be directly added to the membership."
    },
    "access_level": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "AccessLevel",
      "required": [
        ".tag"
      ],
      "properties": {
        ".tag": {
          "enum": [
            "owner",
            "editor",
            "viewer",
            "viewer_no_comment"
          ],
          "type": "string",
          "title": ".Tag",
          "description": "Access level for the collaborator. 'owner' - The collaborator is the owner (can view, edit, and set policies). 'editor' - The collaborator can view and edit the file. 'viewer' - The collaborator can only view the file. 'viewer_no_comment' - The collaborator can only view without commenting."
        }
      },
      "description": "Defines the access level for the new member.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "custom_message": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Custom Message",
      "examples": [
        "Please review this document",
        "Sharing this file for your review"
      ],
      "description": "Custom message to include in the invitation email sent to added members."
    },
    "add_message_as_comment": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Add Message As Comment",
      "default": false,
      "description": "If true and a custom_message is provided, the message will be added as a comment on the file."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for adding members to a file."
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json

  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {
```

## DROPBOX_ADD_FILE_PROPERTIES
Tool to add custom properties to a Dropbox file using a filled property template. Use when you need to tag files with structured metadata like project info, status, or categories.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "AddFilePropertiesRequest",
  "required": [
    "path",
    "property_groups"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "path": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Path",
      "examples": [
        "/test_properties (1).txt",
        "/Documents/report.pdf",
        "id:a4ayc_80_OEAAAAAAAAAXw"
      ],
      "description": "A unique identifier for the file or folder. Can be a file path (e.g., '/test.txt') or a file ID (e.g., 'id:a4ayc_80_OEAAAAAAAAAXw')."
    },
    "property_groups": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "PropertyGroup",
        "required": [
          "template_id",
          "fields"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "fields": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "type": "object",
              "title": "PropertyGroupField",
              "required": [
                "name",
                "value"
              ],
              "properties": {
                "name": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "title": "Name",
                  "examples": [
                    "test_field",
                    "priority",
                    "category"
                  ],
                  "description": "The name or key of the custom property field. Must match a field defined in the property template."
                },
                "value": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "title": "Value",
                  "examples": [
                    "test_value",
                    "high",
                    "important"
                  ],
                  "description": "The value for the custom property field."
                }
              },
              "description": "Represents a single custom property field."
            },
            "title": "Fields",
            "minItems": 1,
            "description": "The property field values for this property group. There can be up to 32 property types per template."
          },
          "template_id": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Template Id",
            "examples": [
              "ptid:4YzeuMHpwCgAAAAAAAAATA",
              "ptid:1a2b3c4d5e6f7g8h9i0j"
            ],
            "description": "A unique identifier for the property template. The template defines the structure and allowed fields for this property group."
          }
        },
        "description": "Represents a group of custom properties associated with a template."
      },
      "title": "Property Groups",
      "minItems": 1,
      "description": "The property groups to be added to the Dropbox file. Each group must reference a valid template that the file doesn't already have."
    },
    "Dropbox-API-Select-User": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Dropbox Api Select User",
      "examples": [
        "dbmid:AACzIks68_T0zljJAk8hGSmt0rLx6g5X9p0"
      ],
      "description": "Team member ID (format: dbmid:...) required when using team tokens. Specifies which team member's account to operate on."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for adding custom properties to a file."
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {
    "AddFilePropertiesResponse": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "AddFilePropertiesResponse",
      "properties": {
        "success": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Success",
          "default": true,
          "description": "Indicates whether the properties were successfully added to the file."
        }
      },
      "description": "Response model for adding custom properties to a file."
    }
  },
  "title": "AddFilePropertiesResponseWrapper",
  "required": [
    "data",
    "successful"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "data": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Data",
      "properties": {
        "success": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Success",
          "default": true,
          "description": "Indicates whether the properties were successfully added to the file."
        }
      },
      "description": "Data from the action execution"
    },
    "error": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Error",
      "description": "Error if any occurred during the execution of the action"
    },
    "successful": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Successful",
      "description": "Whether or not the action execution was successful or not"
    }
  }
}
```

## DROPBOX_ADD_FILE_TAGS
Tool to add a tag to a file or folder in Dropbox. Use when you need to tag items for organization. Tags are automatically converted to lowercase.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "AddFileTagsRequest",
  "required": [
    "path",
    "tag_text"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "path": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Path",
      "examples": [
        "/test-tag-file.txt",
        "/Documents/report.pdf",
        "/Photos"
      ],
      "description": "Path to the file or folder to tag. Must be a valid path in the user's Dropbox."
    },
    "tag_text": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Tag Text",
      "examples": [
        "important",
        "work",
        "personal"
      ],
      "description": "The tag text to add. Will be automatically converted to lowercase letters by Dropbox."
    },
    "Dropbox-API-Select-User": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Dropbox Api Select User",
      "examples": [
        "dbmid:AACzIks68_T0zljJAk8hGSmt0rLx6g5X9p0"
      ],
      "description": "Team member ID (format: dbmid:...) required when using team tokens. Specifies which team member's account to operate on."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for adding a tag to a file or folder."
}
```

## DROPBOX_ADD_FOLDER_MEMBER_ACTION
Tool to add members to a shared folder with specified access levels. Use when an owner or editor needs to invite new members to a shared folder. Members receive invites and must be mounted via mount_folder for full access. Requires appropriate ACL permissions.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "AddFolderMemberRequest",
  "required": [
    "shared_folder_id",
    "members"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "quiet": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Quiet",
      "default": false,
      "description": "Whether to suppress email and device notifications for the added members. If true, members are added silently without notification. Default is false"
    },
    "members": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "AddFolderMember",
        "required": [
          "member",
          "access_level"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "member": {
            "type": "object",
            "title": "Member",
            "required": [
              ".tag"
            ],
            "properties": {
              ".tag": {
                "enum": [
                  "email",
                  "dropbox_id"
                ],
                "type": "string",
                "title": ".Tag",
                "description": "Type of member identifier: 'email' for email address, 'dropbox_id' for Dropbox account ID"
              },
              "email": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Email",
                "examples": [
                  "user@example.com",
                  "colleague@company.com"
                ],
                "description": "Email address of the member to add. Required when tag is 'email'"
              },
              "dropbox_id": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Dropbox Id",
                "description": "Dropbox account ID of the member to add. Required when tag is 'dropbox_id'"
              }
            },
            "description": "The member to add to the shared folder",
            "additionalProperties": false
          },
          "access_level": {
            "type": "object",
            "title": "Access Level",
            "required": [
              ".tag"
            ],
            "properties": {
              ".tag": {
                "enum": [
                  "owner",
                  "editor",
                  "viewer",
                  "viewer_no_comment"
                ],
                "type": "string",
                "title": ".Tag",
                "description": "Access level for the shared folder member: 'owner' - Full control including deletion, 'editor' - Can edit and manage content, 'viewer' - Can view and comment, 'viewer_no_comment' - Can only view without commenting"
              }
            },
            "description": "The access level to grant to the member",
            "additionalProperties": false
          }
        },
        "description": "Specifies a member and their access level."
      },
      "title": "Members",
      "minItems": 1,
      "description": "List of members to add to the shared folder. Each member will receive an invitation to join the folder"
    },
    "custom_message": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Custom Message",
      "description": "Optional custom message to include in the invitation email sent to added members"
```

## DROPBOX_ADD_SHARING_ALLOWLIST
Tool to add domains or email addresses to the team sharing allowlist. Use when team admins need to approve specific domains or emails for sharing. Requires team admin authentication. At least one of 'domains' or 'emails' must be provided, with a maximum of 100 entries per call.

**Input schema:**
```json

  "type": "object",
  "title": "AddSharingAllowlistRequest",
  "properties": {

      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Emails",
      "examples": [
        "user@example.com",
        "partner@company.org",
        "admin@client.net"
      ],
      "maxItems": 100,
      "description": "List of email addresses to add to the allowlist. Each email must be a valid string representation following RFC-5322/822 (e.g., 'user@example.com'). Maximum 100 entries per call. At least one of 'domains' or 'emails' must be provided"
    },
    "domains": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Domains",
      "examples": [
        "example.com",
        "partner.org",
        "client-company.net"
      ],
      "maxItems": 100,
      "description": "List of domains to add to the allowlist. Each domain must be a valid string representation following RFC-1034/5 (e.g., 'example.com', 'subdomain.example.org'). Maximum 100 entries per call. At least one of 'domains' or 'emails' must be provided"
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for adding entries to the team sharing allowlist."
}
```

## DROPBOX_ADD_TEAM_MEMBERS
Tool to add new members to a Dropbox team. Use when you need to invite users to join the team with specified roles and settings. Maximum of 20 members per request. Requires team admin credentials.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "AddTeamMembersRequest",
  "required": [
    "new_members"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "force_async": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Force Async",
      "default": false,
      "description": "Whether to force the operation to happen asynchronously. If true, returns an async_job_id to poll for completion. Default is false"
    },
    "new_members": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "NewMemberProfile",
        "required": [
          "member_email",
          "member_given_name",
          "member_surname"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "role": {
            "type": "object",
            "title": "AdminRole",
            "required": [
              ".tag"
            ],
            "properties": {
              ".tag": {
                "enum": [
                  "team_admin",
                  "user_management_admin",
                  "support_admin",
                  "limited_admin",
                  "member_only"
                ],
                "type": "string",
                "title": ".Tag",
                "description": "Admin tier: 'team_admin' for full admin privileges, 'user_management_admin' for user management, 'support_admin' for support access, 'limited_admin' for limited privileges, 'member_only' for no admin privileges"
              }
            },
            "description": "Admin tier for the role.",
            "additionalProperties": false
          },
          "member_email": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Member Email",
            "examples": [
              "test.member@example.com",
              "newuser@company.com"
            ],
            "description": "Email address of the new team member. Must be a valid email format"
          },
          "member_surname": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Member Surname",
            "examples": [
              "Doe",
              "Smith"
            ],
            "description": "The last name of the new team member. Required for team invitation"
          },
          "member_given_name": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Member Given Name",
            "examples": [
              "John",
              "Jane"
            ],
            "description": "The first name of the new team member. Required for team invitation"
          },
          "member_external_id": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Member External Id",
            "description": "External ID for the member, useful for syncing with external systems"
          },
          "send_welcome_email": {
            "type": "boolean",
            "title": "Send Welcome Email",
            "default": true,
            "description": "Whether to send a welcome email to the member. Set to false for SSO flows handling announcements themselves. Default is true"
          },
          "member_persistent_id": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Member Persistent Id",
            "description": "Persistent ID for member. Only available to teams using persistent ID SAML configuration"
          },
          "is_directory_restricted": {
            "type": "boolean",
            "title": "Is Directory Restricted",
            "description": "Whether the user is directory restricted. Directory restricted users can only see members in their team directory"
          }
        },
        "description": "Profile information for a new team member to add."
      },
      "title": "New Members",
      "maxItems": 20,
      "minItems": 1,
      "description": "List of new members to add to the team. Maximum of 20 members per request"
    }
  }
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {
    "AddTeamMembersResponse": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "AddTeamMembersResponse",
      "required": [
        ".tag"
      ],
      "properties": {
        ".tag": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": ".Tag",
          "description": "Response type: 'complete' if operation finished synchronously, 'async_job_id' if running asynchronously"
        },
        "complete": {
          "type": "array",

          },
          "title": "Complete",

        },

        }
      },
      "description": "Response from adding team members."

  "required": [
    "data",
    "successful"
  ],

      "required": [

      ],
      "properties": {
        ".tag": {

          "title": ".Tag",

        },
        "complete": {
          "type": "array",

          },

        },
```

## DROPBOX_ADD_TEAM_MEMBERS_SECONDARY_EMAILS
Tool to add secondary email addresses to Dropbox team members. Use when you need to associate additional email addresses with team member accounts. Requires team admin credentials.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "AddTeamMembersSecondaryEmailsRequest",
  "required": [
    "new_secondary_emails"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "new_secondary_emails": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "UserSecondaryEmailsArg",
        "required": [
          "user",
          "secondary_emails"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "user": {
            "anyOf": [
              {
                "type": "object",
                "title": "UserSelectorTeamMemberId",
                "required": [
                  "team_member_id"
                ],
                "properties": {
                  ".tag": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "const": "team_member_id",
                    "title": ".Tag",
                    "default": "team_member_id",
                    "description": "Selector type - must be 'team_member_id'"
                  },
                  "team_member_id": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "title": "Team Member Id",
                    "examples": [
                      "dbmid:efgh5678",
                      "dbmid:test1234"
                    ],
                    "description": "The team member ID to add secondary emails to. Format: dbmid:XXXX"
                  }
                },
                "description": "User selector using team member ID."
              },
              {
                "type": "object",
                "title": "UserSelectorEmail",
                "required": [
                  "email"
                ],
                "properties": {
                  ".tag": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "const": "email",
                    "title": ".Tag",
                    "default": "email",
                    "description": "Selector type - must be 'email'"
                  },
                  "email": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "title": "Email",
                    "examples": [
                      "user@example.com"
                    ],
                    "description": "The email address of the team member to add secondary emails to"
                  }
                },
                "description": "User selector using email address."
              }
            ],
            "title": "User",
            "description": "User to add secondary emails to. Can be identified by team_member_id or email"
          },
          "secondary_emails": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "type": "string"
            },
            "title": "Secondary Emails",
            "examples": [
              [
                "bob2@hotmail.com",
                "bob@inst.gov"
              ]
            ],
            "minItems": 1,
            "description": "List of secondary email addresses to add to the user. Must be valid email addresses"
          }
        },
        "description": "Specification for adding secondary emails to a user."
      },
      "title": "New Secondary Emails",
      "minItems": 1,
      "description": "List of users and their secondary emails to add. Each entry specifies a user (by ID or email) and the secondary emails to add for them"
    }
  }
}
```

## DROPBOX_ADD_TEAM_PROPERTIES_TEMPLATE
Tool to add a property template for a team in Dropbox. Use when you need to create a standardized set of custom properties that can be applied to files and folders. Requires team admin permissions and a Dropbox Business account.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "AddTeamPropertiesTemplateRequest",
  "required": [
    "name",
    "description",
    "fields"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Name",
      "examples": [
        "Project Metadata",
        "Document Properties",
        "File Classification"
      ],
      "maxLength": 256,
      "description": "Display name for the template. Template names can be up to 256 bytes."
    },
    "fields": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "PropertyFieldDefinition",
        "required": [
          "name",
          "description",
          "type"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "name": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Name",
            "examples": [
              "project_id",
              "status",
              "priority"
            ],
            "maxLength": 256,
            "description": "Key of the property field being described. Property field keys can be up to 256 bytes."
          },
          "type": {
            "type": "object",
            "title": "Type",
            "required": [
              ".tag"
            ],
            "properties": {
              ".tag": {
                "type": "string",
                "const": "string",
                "title": ".Tag",
                "description": "The type of the property field. Currently only 'string' is supported."
              }
            },
            "description": "Data type of the value of this property field. This type will be enforced upon property creation and modifications.",
            "additionalProperties": false
          },
          "description": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Description",
            "examples": [
              "Unique identifier for the project",
              "Current project status"
            ],
            "maxLength": 1024,
            "description": "Description of the property field. Property field descriptions can be up to 1024 bytes."
          }
        },
        "description": "Definition of a property field in a template."
      },
      "title": "Fields",
      "maxItems": 32,
      "minItems": 1,
```

## DROPBOX_ALPHA_UPLOAD_FILE
Tool to upload a new file to Dropbox using the alpha upload endpoint. Use when uploading files up to 150 MiB. Note that the behavior of this alpha endpoint is unstable and subject to change.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "AlphaUploadFileRequest",
  "required": [
    "path"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "mode": {
      "enum": [
        "add",
        "overwrite"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Mode",
      "default": "add",
      "examples": [
        "add",
        "overwrite"
      ],
      "description": "Selects what to do if the file already exists."
    },
    "mute": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Mute",
      "default": false,
      "description": "If true, this tells the clients that this modification shouldn't result in a user notification."
    },
    "path": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Path",
      "examples": [
        "/test_upload_alpha.txt",
        "/Documents/report.pdf",
        "/Images/photo.jpg"
      ],
      "description": "Path in the user's Dropbox to save the file. Must start with '/' and include the filename."
    },
    "content": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "FileUploadable",
      "required": [
        "name",
        "mimetype",
        "s3key"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "name": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Name",
          "examples": [
            "document.pdf",
            "image.jpg",
            "report.docx"
          ],
          "description": "The filename that will be used when uploading the file to the destination service"
        },
        "s3key": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "S3Key",
          "examples": [
            "47563/gmail/GET_ATTACHMENT/response/12345"
          ],
          "description": "The S3 key of a publicly accessible file, typically returned from a previous download action that stored the file in S3. This key references an existing file that can be uploaded to another service."
        },
        "mimetype": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Mimetype",
          "examples": [
            "application/pdf",
            "image/jpeg",
            "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document"
          ],
          "description": "The MIME type of the file"
        }
      },
      "description": "File to be uploaded. Supports various formats including text, images, and PDFs. Alternatively, you may omit this and use 'local_file_path'.",
      "file_uploadable": true,
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "autorename": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Autorename",
      "default": false,
      "description": "If there's a conflict as determined by mode, have the Dropbox server try to autorename the file to avoid conflict."
    },
    "client_modified": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Client Modified",
      "examples": [
        "2015-05-12T15:50:38Z"
      ],
      "description": "The value to store as the client_modified timestamp in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2015-05-12T15:50:38Z'). Dropbox automatically records the time at which the file was written to the Dropbox servers."
    },
    "local_file_path": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Local File Path",
      "examples": [
        "/tmp/test_file.txt",
        "/abs/path/to/document.pdf"
      ],
      "description": "Absolute path to a local file to upload. If provided, the action will read raw bytes from this path instead of the file reference. Useful for testing or when the file is available locally."
    },
    "property_groups": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "PropertyGroup",
        "required": [
          "template_id",
          "fields"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "fields": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "type": "object",
              "title": "PropertyField",
              "required": [
                "name",
                "value"
              ],
              "properties": {
                "name": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "title": "Name",
                  "description": "Name of the property field."
                },
                "value": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "title": "Value",
                  "description": "Value of the property field."
                }
              }
            },
            "title": "Fields",
            "description": "List of property field key-value pairs."
          },
          "template_id": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Template Id",
            "description": "A unique identifier for the property template."
          }
        }
      },
      "title": "Property Groups",
      "description": "List of custom properties to add to file."
    },
    "dropbox_api_select_user": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Dropbox Api Select User",
      "examples": [
        "dbid:AAH4f99T0taONIb-OurWxbNQ6ywGRopQngc",
        "dbmid:AAHcP_80seJ7qgSwKG9Hq8xC9MhJE9RmB0c"
      ],
      "description": "Optional. For team accounts: Dropbox account ID or team member ID to operate on. Required when using a Dropbox Business team token. Format: 'dbid:...' or team_member_id."
    }
  }
}
```

## DROPBOX_APPEND_UPLOAD_SESSION
Tool to append more data to an existing upload session. Use when uploading large files in chunks. When the 'close' parameter is set to true, this call will close the session. A single request should not upload more than 150 MiB.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "AppendUploadSessionRequest",
  "required": [
    "cursor"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "close": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Close",
      "default": false,
      "description": "If true, the upload session will be closed after appending this data. Once closed, no more data can be appended to the session."
    },
    "cursor": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Cursor",
      "required": [
        "session_id",
        "offset"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "offset": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "Offset",
          "minimum": 0,
          "examples": [
            0,
            1024,
            1048576
          ],
          "description": "The amount of data in bytes that has been uploaded so far. This is used to ensure upload data isn't lost or duplicated in the event of a network error."
        },
        "session_id": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Session Id",
          "examples": [
            "pid_upload_session:ABIKOTD-uhUwk0o047_t2A39edqHZv7PqlR2ugZTUbw21bBCuA"
          ],
          "description": "The upload session ID returned by upload_session/start."
        }
      },
      "description": "Cursor information containing the session_id and current offset in bytes.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "content": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "FileUploadable",
      "required": [
        "name",
        "mimetype",
        "s3key"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "name": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Name",
          "examples": [
            "document.pdf",
            "image.jpg",
            "report.docx"
          ],
          "description": "The filename that will be used when uploading the file to the destination service"
        },
        "s3key": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "S3Key",
          "examples": [
            "47563/gmail/GET_ATTACHMENT/response/12345"
          ],
          "description": "The S3 key of a publicly accessible file, typically returned from a previous download action that stored the file in S3. This key references an existing file that can be uploaded to another service."
        },
        "mimetype": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Mimetype",
          "examples": [
            "application/pdf",
            "image/jpeg",
            "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document"
          ],
          "description": "The MIME type of the file"
        }
      },
      "description": "File data to append to the upload session. Alternatively, you may omit this and use 'local_file_path'.",
      "file_uploadable": true,
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "local_file_path": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Local File Path",
      "examples": [
        "/tmp/data.bin",
        "/abs/path/to/chunk.dat"
      ],
      "description": "Absolute path to a local file to upload. If provided, the action will read raw bytes from this path instead of the file reference. Useful for testing or when the file is available locally."
    }
  }
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {

      "type": "object",
```

## DROPBOX_APPEND_UPLOAD_SESSION_BATCH
Tool to append data to multiple upload sessions in a single request. Use when you need to upload data to multiple ongoing upload sessions efficiently. The file content for each session should be concatenated in the request body in the order specified by entries. A single request should not upload more than 150 MiB. The maximum size of a file one can upload to an upload session is 2^41 - 2^22 (2,199,019,061,248) bytes.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "AppendUploadSessionBatchRequest",
  "required": [
    "entries",
    "data"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "data": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Data",
      "format": "binary",
      "description": "Concatenated binary data for all upload sessions. The data for each session should be concatenated in the order specified in the entries list. Each chunk's length must match the corresponding entry's length field."
    },
    "entries": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "UploadSessionAppendBatchArgEntry",
        "required": [
          "cursor",
          "length"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "close": {
            "type": "boolean",
            "title": "Close",
            "default": false,
            "description": "If true, the upload session will be closed after appending this data. Set to true when this is the final chunk for this session."
          },
          "cursor": {
            "type": "object",
            "title": "Cursor",
            "required": [
              "session_id",
              "offset"
            ],
            "properties": {
              "offset": {
                "type": "integer",
                "title": "Offset",
                "minimum": 0,
                "examples": [
                  0,
                  1024,
                  5242880
                ],
                "description": "The amount of data already uploaded to this session in bytes. Must match the actual amount previously uploaded."
              },
              "session_id": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Session Id",
                "examples": [
                  "pid_upload_session:ABIKOUDCsWWOgGdtWNm2an-FHOPmw0W9zejs1OOQmkD9nDw_0A"
                ],
                "description": "The upload session ID returned by upload_session/start."
              }
            },
            "description": "Cursor identifying the upload session and current offset for this entry.",
            "additionalProperties": false
          },
          "length": {
            "type": "integer",
            "title": "Length",
            "examples": [
              23,
              1024,
              5242880
            ],
            "description": "The number of bytes to append to this session from the concatenated request body. Must be positive.",
            "exclusiveMinimum": 0
          }
        },
        "description": "Single entry in the batch append request."
      },
      "title": "Entries",
      "examples": [
        [
          {
            "close": false,
            "cursor": {
              "offset": 0,
              "session_id": "pid_upload_session:ABIKOUDCsWWOgGdtWNm2an-FHOPmw0W9zejs1OOQmkD9nDw_0A"
            },
            "length": 23
          },
          {
            "close": false,
            "cursor": {
              "offset": 0,
              "session_id": "pid_upload_session:ABIKOWkEtG7FziZAUMOmoMO9PqPN8YXp_1T2ESGA8m3i91Koww"
            },
            "length": 23
          }
        ]
      ],
      "minItems": 1,
      "description": "List of upload session entries to append data to. Each entry specifies the session, how many bytes to read from the request body, and whether to close the session. The data for each entry should be concatenated in the request body in the same order as this list."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for appending data to multiple upload sessions in batch."
}
```

## DROPBOX_ARCHIVE_TEAM_FOLDER
Tool to archive an active team folder in Dropbox. Sets the team folder's status to archived and removes all folder and file members. Use when you need to archive a team folder that is no longer in active use. The folder must be active before it can be archived.

**Input schema:**

```json
      "title": "Team Folder Id",

        "123456789"

      "description": "The ID of the team folder to archive. You can get this from list team folders action. The team folder must be active to be archived."

      "title": "Force Async Off",
      "description": "Whether to force the operation to run synchronously. If true, the operation will complete synchronously and return metadata immediately. If false or not specified, large operations may complete asynchronously."

  },
  "description": "Request model for archiving a team folder."
}
```

## DROPBOX_CHECK_COPY_BATCH
Tool to check the status of an asynchronous copy batch job in Dropbox. Use when you have an async_job_id from a previous copy_batch operation and need to poll its status. Returns 'in_progress', 'complete' with results for each entry, or 'failed' with error details.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CheckCopyBatchRequest",
  "required": [
    "async_job_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "async_job_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Async Job Id",
      "examples": [
        "dbjid:AAA9W0f2HDJ_ueldO2YD4S79kpnkhll-mrToXietsd8rGZzchE9jsW0kaCDsvq-YTzDQrw9sYwicXx9kKkxCWNGG"
      ],
      "description": "Id of the asynchronous job. This is the value of a response returned from the method that launched the job."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for checking the status of a copy batch job."
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {
    "CheckCopyBatchResponse": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "CheckCopyBatchResponse",
      "required": [
        ".tag"
      ],
      "properties": {
        ".tag": {
          "enum": [
            "in_progress",
            "complete",
            "failed",
            "invalid_async_job_id",
            "internal_error",
            "other"
          ],
          "type": "string",
          "title": ".Tag",
          "description": "Status of the asynchronous job. in_progress: still processing. complete: finished successfully. failed/invalid_async_job_id/internal_error/other: various error states."
        },
        "entries": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "object",
            "additionalProperties": true
          },
          "title": "Entries",
          "description": "Present when tag is 'complete'. Each entry corresponds to an item in the original copy batch request and contains either success metadata or failure error details."
        }
      },
      "description": "Response from checking the status of a copy batch job.\nThe tag field indicates the current status: in_progress, complete, or failed."
    }
  },
  "title": "CheckCopyBatchResponseWrapper",
  "required": [
    "data",
    "successful"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "data": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Data",
      "required": [
        ".tag"
      ],
      "properties": {
        ".tag": {
          "enum": [
            "in_progress",
            "complete",
            "failed",
            "invalid_async_job_id",
            "internal_error",
            "other"
          ],
          "type": "string",
          "title": ".Tag",
          "description": "Status of the asynchronous job. in_progress: still processing. complete: finished successfully. failed/invalid_async_job_id/internal_error/other: various error states."
        },
        "entries": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "object",
            "additionalProperties": true
          },

        }
      },

    },
    "error": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Error",
      "description": "Error if any occurred during the execution of the action"
    },
    "successful": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Successful",
      "description": "Whether or not the action execution was successful or not"
    }
  }
}
```

```json
      ],
      "description": "Id of the asynchronous job. This is the value of a response returned from the method that launched the job."
```

## DROPBOX_CHECK_FOLDER_BATCH
Tool to check the status of an asynchronous folder batch creation job. Use when you need to poll the status of a create_folder_batch operation. Returns 'in_progress', 'complete' with results, or 'failed' with error details.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CheckFolderBatchRequest",
  "required": [
    "async_job_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "async_job_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Async Job Id",
      "examples": [
        "dbjid:AABoj8Vt1v4sW75PK135T6dbQLwXD1yPwF6uHRcaxqX0qDvNXhznIsvYKfHYUA9LxEhPCIWTR4p_2ovDqRi345VM"
      ],
      "description": "ID of the asynchronous job. This is the value returned from the create_folder_batch method."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for checking folder batch creation status."
}
```

## DROPBOX_CHECK_JOB_STATUS
Tool to check the status of an asynchronous sharing job in Dropbox. Use when you have an async_job_id from a previous sharing operation (like unshare_folder, remove_folder_member) and need to poll its status. Returns 'in_progress', 'complete', 'failed' with error details, or polling errors.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CheckJobStatusRequest",
  "required": [
    "async_job_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "async_job_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Async Job Id",
      "examples": [
        "dbjid:AACD-aM8Oi5GiB_EqlBYrJkGDEn7tnoSiRcq6xDKrb6TiphCH0wTGpI0bB8RxddGIOQSTAWgU1zz69S4XUwTWcSr"
      ],
      "description": "Id of the asynchronous job. This is the value of a response returned from the method that launched the job."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for checking the status of an asynchronous sharing job."
}
```

## DROPBOX_CHECK_MOVE_BATCH
Tool to check the status of an asynchronous move batch job. Use when you need to poll the status of a batch move operation started with move_batch_v2. Returns a list of results for each entry when complete.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CheckMoveBatchRequest",
  "required": [
    "async_job_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "async_job_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Async Job Id",
      "examples": [
        "dbjid:AADqyYPi40MIgqklWOM-Mp7inh5v2jPlwhPTpREgh4cp8aQAHArn6pvoHeqYL2Tp9jEOA4tvmj1itOUKTVAFxXMw"
      ],
      "description": "Id of the asynchronous job. This is the value of a response returned from the method that launched the job."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for checking the status of an asynchronous move batch job."
}
```

**Output schema:**

## DROPBOX_CHECK_MOVE_FORMER_MEMBER_FILES_JOB_STATUS
Tool to check the status of an asynchronous move former member files job. Use when you have an async_job_id from a previous team/members/move_former_member_files operation and need to poll its completion status. Returns 'in_progress', 'complete', 'failed' with error details, or error states like 'invalid_async_job_id'.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CheckMoveFormerMemberFilesJobStatusRequest",
  "required": [
    "async_job_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "async_job_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Async Job Id",
      "examples": [
        "34g93hh34h04y384084",
        "dbjid:AABCD1234567890"
      ],
      "description": "Id of the asynchronous job returned from team/members/move_former_member_files. This is used to poll the status of the file move operation."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for checking the status of an asynchronous move former member files job."
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json

          "description": "The type of error that occurred during the move former member files operation."
        }
      },

      ],
      "properties": {

          "type": "string",
          "title": ".Tag",
          "description": "Status of the asynchronous job. 'in_progress': still processing. 'complete': finished successfully. 'failed': job failed with error details. 'invalid_async_job_id': the job ID is invalid. 'internal_error': something went wrong on Dropbox's end."
        },
        "failed": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "Failed",
          "required": [
            ".tag"
          ],
          "properties": {
            ".tag": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": ".Tag",
              "description": "The type of error that occurred during the move former member files operation."
            }
          },
          "description": "Error details when tag is 'failed'. Contains information about what went wrong during the file move operation."
        }
      },
      "description": "Response from checking the status of an asynchronous move former member files job.\nThe tag field indicates the current status or error type."
    }
  },

  "required": [
    "data",
    "successful"
  ],
  "properties": {

      "title": "Data",

      ],
      "properties": {

          "description": "Status of the asynchronous job. 'in_progress': still processing. 'complete': finished successfully. 'failed': job failed with error details. 'invalid_async_job_id': the job ID is invalid. 'internal_error': something went wrong on Dropbox's end."
        },
        "failed": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "Failed",
          "required": [
            ".tag"
          ],
          "properties": {
            ".tag": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": ".Tag",

            }
```

Tool to check the status of an asynchronous remove folder member job in Dropbox. Use when you have an async_job_id from a previous remove_folder_member operation and need to poll its status. Returns 'in_progress', 'complete' with access level info, or 'failed' with error details.

```json
      ],
      "description": "Id of the asynchronous job. This is the value of a response returned from the method that launched the job."
```

## DROPBOX_CHECK_SHARE_JOB_STATUS
Tool to check the status of an asynchronous folder sharing job in Dropbox. Use when you need to poll the status of a folder share operation that was initiated asynchronously. Returns 'in_progress', 'complete' with folder metadata, 'failed' with error details, or polling error status.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CheckShareJobStatusRequest",
  "required": [
    "async_job_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "async_job_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Async Job Id",
      "examples": [
        "dbjid:AABzGEzOnfiAAEN85fWdkEADcgkMoSXuqPmBsY_vJEKk_pUn5N2rLXMQ7hLs67sh4UZiFcP69U4nNAmUim_IqdO4"
      ],
      "description": "Id of the asynchronous job. This is the value of a response returned from the method that launched the job."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request to check the status of an asynchronous folder sharing job."
}
```

## DROPBOX_CHECK_TEAM_FOLDER_ARCHIVE
Tool to check the status of an asynchronous team folder archive job in Dropbox. Use when you have an async_job_id from a previous team_folder/archive operation and need to poll its status. Returns 'in_progress' while archiving, 'complete' with team folder metadata when done, or error states like 'invalid_async_job_id'.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CheckTeamFolderArchiveRequest",
  "required": [
    "async_job_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "async_job_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Async Job Id",
      "examples": [
        "dbjid:AACyVg9Hu8Lp5jLDVqbUGMkeDUIQvFMV8QkHnvV9lbXOFKCkQeqWdDiCuHUphKDxBziprdjNjpswqqoG9xUJ9upm"
      ],
      "description": "Id of the asynchronous job returned from the team_folder/archive method that launched the archive operation."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for checking the status of a team folder archive job."
}
```

**Output schema:**

## DROPBOX_CHECK_UPLOAD_BATCH
Tool to check the status of an asynchronous upload batch job in Dropbox. Use when you need to poll the status of a batch upload operation initiated by upload_session/finish_batch. Returns 'in_progress', 'complete' with per-entry results, or error status.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CheckUploadBatchRequest",
  "required": [
    "async_job_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "async_job_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Async Job Id",
      "examples": [
        "pid_upload_result:ABIKOTGn3VW8UUPSFEGZIJY7TpYv-HSdyGw8Y0DBsz-jPTf8"
      ],
      "description": "Id of the asynchronous job. This is the value of a response returned from the method that launched the job."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request to check the status of an asynchronous upload batch job."
}
```

```json
                  "title": ".Tag",
                  "description": "The batch upload has finished."
                },
                "entries": {
                  "type": "array",
                  "items": {
                    "anyOf": [
                      {
                        "type": "object",
                        "title": "UploadSessionFinishBatchResultSuccess",
                        "required": [
                          ".tag",
                          "name",
                          "id"
                        ],
                        "properties": {
                          "id": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "title": "Id",
                            "description": "A unique identifier for the file."
                          },
                          "rev": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "title": "Rev",
                            "description": "A unique identifier for the current revision of a file."
                          },
                          ".tag": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "const": "success",
                            "title": ".Tag",
                            "description": "Indicates this entry represents a successful upload."
                          },
                          "name": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "title": "Name",
                            "description": "The last component of the path."
                          },
                          "size": {
                            "type": "integer",
                            "title": "Size",
                            "description": "The file size in bytes."
                          },
                          "path_lower": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "title": "Path Lower",
                            "description": "The lowercased full path in the user's Dropbox."
                          },
                          "content_hash": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "title": "Content Hash",
                            "description": "A hash of the file content."
                          },
                          "path_display": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "title": "Path Display",
                            "description": "The cased path to be used for display purposes only."
                          },
                          "client_modified": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "title": "Client Modified",
                            "format": "date-time",
                            "description": "The modification time set by the desktop client."
                          },
                          "is_downloadable": {
                            "type": "boolean",
                            "title": "Is Downloadable",
                            "description": "If true, file can be downloaded directly."
                          },
                          "server_modified": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "title": "Server Modified",
                            "format": "date-time",
                            "description": "The last time the file was modified on Dropbox."
                          }
                        },
                        "description": "Data for a successful upload operation in a batch."
                      },
                      {
                        "type": "object",
                        "title": "UploadSessionFinishBatchResultFailure",
                        "required": [
                          ".tag",
                          "failure"
                        ],
                        "properties": {
                          ".tag": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "const": "failure",
                            "title": ".Tag",
                            "description": "Indicates this entry represents a failed upload."
                          },
                          "failure": {
                            "anyOf": [
                              {
                                "type": "object",
                                "title": "UploadSessionFinishErrorLookupFailed",
                                "required": [
                                  ".tag"
                                ],
                                "properties": {
                                  ".tag": {
                                    "type": "string",
                                    "const": "lookup_failed",
                                    "title": ".Tag",
                                    "description": "The session ID was not found or the session is closed."
                                  },
                                  "lookup_failed": {
                                    "type": "object",
                                    "title": "Lookup Failed",
                                    "required": [
                                      ".tag"
                                    ],
                                    "properties": {
                                      ".tag": {
                                        "type": "string",
                                        "title": ".Tag",
                                        "description": "The type of lookup error (e.g., 'not_found', 'incorrect_offset', 'closed')."
                                      }
                                    },
                                    "description": "The specific lookup error that occurred."
                                  }
                                },
                                "description": "Upload error due to session lookup failure."
                              },
                              {
                                "type": "object",
                                "title": "UploadSessionFinishErrorPathError",
                                "required": [
                                  ".tag"
                                ],
                                "properties": {
                                  ".tag": {
                                    "type": "string",
                                    "const": "path",
                                    "title": ".Tag",
                                    "description": "Unable to save the uploaded file to the given path."
                                  },
                                  "path": {
                                    "type": "object",
                                    "title": "Path",
                                    "required": [
                                      ".tag"
                                    ],
                                    "properties": {
                                      ".tag": {
                                        "type": "string",
                                        "title": ".Tag",
                                        "description": "The type of write error (e.g., 'malformed_path', 'conflict', 'no_write_permission', 'insufficient_space', 'disallowed_name')."
                                      }
                                    },
                                    "description": "The specific write error that occurred."
                                  }
                                },
                                "description": "Upload error due to path error."
                              },
                              {
                                "type": "object",
                                "title": "UploadSessionFinishErrorTooManyWriteOps",
                                "required": [
                                  ".tag"
                                ],
                                "properties": {
                                  ".tag": {
                                    "type": "string",
                                    "const": "too_many_write_operations",
                                    "title": ".Tag",
                                    "description": "There are too many write operations in user's Dropbox."
                                  }
                                },
                                "description": "Error when there are too many write operations."
                              },
                              {
                                "type": "object",
                                "title": "UploadSessionFinishErrorTooManySharedFolderTargets",
                                "required": [
                                  ".tag"
                                ],
                                "properties": {
                                  ".tag": {
                                    "type": "string",
                                    "const": "too_many_shared_folder_targets",
                                    "title": ".Tag",
                                    "description": "Too many shared folder targets to add."
                                  }
                                },
                                "description": "Error when there are too many shared folder targets."
                              },
                              {
                                "type": "object",
                                "title": "UploadSessionFinishErrorOther",
                                "required": [
                                  ".tag"
                                ],
                                "properties": {
                                  ".tag": {
                                    "type": "string",
                                    "const": "other",
                                    "title": ".Tag",
                                    "description": "An unspecified error occurred."
                                  }
                                },
                                "description": "Other upload error."
                              }
                            ],
                            "title": "Failure",
                            "description": "The error that caused the upload to fail."
                          }
                        },
                        "description": "Data for a failed upload operation in a batch."
                      }
                    ]
                  },
                  "title": "Entries",
                  "description": "Each entry in the original upload batch request appears at the same position in this list. Check the .tag field of each entry to determine if the upload succeeded or failed."
                }
              },
              "description": "The batch upload job has completed."
            },
            {
              "type": "object",
              "title": "PollErrorInvalidAsyncJobId",
              "required": [
                ".tag"
              ],
              "properties": {
                ".tag": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "const": "invalid_async_job_id",
                  "title": ".Tag",
                  "description": "The job ID is invalid."
                }
              },
              "description": "Error when the async job ID is invalid."
            },
            {
              "type": "object",
              "title": "PollErrorInternalError",
              "required": [
                ".tag"
              ],
              "properties": {
                ".tag": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "const": "internal_error",
                  "title": ".Tag",
                  "description": "Something went wrong with the job on Dropbox's end. You'll need to verify that the action you were taking succeeded, and if not, try again."
                }
              },
              "description": "Error when something went wrong on Dropbox's end."
            },
            {
              "type": "object",
              "title": "PollErrorOther",
              "required": [
                ".tag"
              ],
              "properties": {
                ".tag": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "const": "other",
                  "title": ".Tag",
                  "description": "An unspecified error occurred while polling."
                }
              },
              "description": "Other polling error."
            }
          ],
          "title": "Status",
          "description": "The current status of the upload batch job. Check the .tag field to determine the status: 'in_progress' means the job is still running, 'complete' means it finished (check entries for per-file results), or error tags indicate polling errors."
        }
      },
      "description": "Data from the action execution"
    },
    "error": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Error",
      "description": "Error if any occurred during the execution of the action"
    },
    "successful": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Successful",
      "description": "Whether or not the action execution was successful or not"
    }
  }
}
```

## DROPBOX_CHECK_USER
Tool to test Dropbox API connection and validate access token by echoing back a supplied string. Use when you need to verify that the Dropbox API is accessible and the access token is valid.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "DropboxCheckUserRequest",
  "properties": {
    "query": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Query",
      "default": "",
      "examples": [
        "foo",
        "test connection",
        "hello dropbox"
      ],
      "maxLength": 500,
      "description": "The string that you'd like to be echoed back to you. Maximum length is 500 characters."
    }
  }
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {
    "DropboxCheckUserResponse": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "DropboxCheckUserResponse",
      "required": [
        "result"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "result": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Result",
          "description": "If everything worked correctly, this would be the same as query."
        }
      }
    }
  },
  "title": "DropboxCheckUserResponseWrapper",
  "required": [
    "data",
    "successful"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "data": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Data",
      "required": [
        "result"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "result": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Result",
          "description": "If everything worked correctly, this would be the same as query."
        }
      },
      "description": "Data from the action execution"
    },
    "error": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Error",
      "description": "Error if any occurred during the execution of the action"
    },
    "successful": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Successful",
      "description": "Whether or not the action execution was successful or not"
    }
  }
}
```

## DROPBOX_COPY_BATCH
Tool to copy multiple files or folders to different locations at once in Dropbox. Use when you need to duplicate multiple items efficiently. This operation may complete synchronously or return a job ID for async processing. Use copy_batch/check:2 to check async job status.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "DropboxCopyBatchRequest",
  "required": [
    "entries"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "entries": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "RelocationPath",
        "required": [
          "from_path",
          "to_path"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "to_path": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "To Path",
            "examples": [
              "/Homework/archive/math_prime_numbers.txt",
              "/Photos/2024/Vacation_copy"
            ],
            "description": "Path in the user's Dropbox that is the destination. This path is case-sensitive."
          },
          "from_path": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "From Path",
            "examples": [
              "/Homework/math/prime_numbers.txt",
              "/Photos/Vacation"
            ],
            "description": "Path in the user's Dropbox to be copied. This path is case-sensitive."
          }
        },
        "description": "Represents a single entry to be copied in a batch operation."
      },
      "title": "Entries",
      "minItems": 1,
      "description": "List of entries to be copied. Each entry is a RelocationPath with from_path and to_path."
    },
    "autorename": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Autorename",
      "default": false,
      "description": "If there's a conflict with any file, have the Dropbox server try to autorename that file to avoid the conflict. The default is false."
    },
    "dropbox_api_select_user": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Dropbox Api Select User",
      "examples": [
        "dbmid:AACzIks68_T0zljJAk8hGSmt0rLx6g5X9p0"
      ],
      "description": "Team member ID (format: dbmid:...) required when using team tokens. Specifies which team member's account to operate on."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for copying multiple files or folders in Dropbox."
}
```

## DROPBOX_COPY_FILE_OR_FOLDER
Tool to copy a file or folder to a different location in Dropbox. Use when you need to duplicate content without removing the original. If the source path is a folder, all its contents will be copied.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "DropboxCopyFileOrFolderRequest",
  "required": [
    "from_path",
    "to_path"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "to_path": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "To Path",
      "examples": [
        "/Homework/archive/math_prime_numbers.txt",
        "/Photos/2024/Vacation_copy"
      ],
      "description": "Path in the user's Dropbox that is the destination. This path is case-sensitive."
    },
    "from_path": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "From Path",
      "examples": [
        "/Homework/math/prime_numbers.txt",
        "/Photos/Vacation"
      ],
      "description": "Path in the user's Dropbox to be copied. This path is case-sensitive."
    },
    "autorename": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Autorename",
      "default": false,
      "description": "If there's a conflict (e.g., a file with the same name already exists at the destination), have the Dropbox server try to auto-rename the file to avoid the conflict. The default is false."
    },
    "allow_shared_folder": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Allow Shared Folder",
      "default": false,
      "description": "If true, allows copying of shared folders. Note: This flag has no effect in current API version. The default is false."
    },
    "dropbox_api_select_user": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Dropbox Api Select User",
      "examples": [
        "dbmid:AACzIks68_T0zljJAk8hGSmt0rLx6g5X9p0"
      ],
      "description": "Team member ID (format: dbmid:...) required when using team tokens. Specifies which team member's account to operate on."
    },
    "allow_ownership_transfer": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Allow Ownership Transfer",
      "default": false,
      "description": "Allow moves by owner even if it would result in an ownership transfer for the content being moved. Note: This does not apply to copies. The default is false."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for copying a file or folder in Dropbox."
}
```

## DROPBOX_CREATE_FILE_REQUEST
Tool to create a new file request in Dropbox. Use when you need to request files from others by generating a unique link for uploads to a specified Dropbox folder, optionally with a deadline.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateFileRequestRequest",
  "required": [
    "title",
    "destination"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "open": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Open",
      "default": true,
      "description": "Whether the file request should be open by default. If true, the file request will start accepting files immediately."
    },
    "title": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Title",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "The title of the new file request. Must be 1 character or more."
    },
    "deadline": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "FileRequestDeadlineRequest",
      "properties": {
        "due_date": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Due Date",
          "format": "date-time",
          "description": "The deadline for the file request. Timestamps should be in UTC. Example: '2024-08-15T17:00:00Z'"
        },
        "allow_late_uploads": {
          "enum": [
            "seven_days",
            "thirty_days",
            "always",
            "false",
            null
          ],
          "title": "Allow Late Uploads",
          "description": "Specifies the policy for uploads after the deadline. 'seven_days' or 'thirty_days' allows uploads for that period. 'always' allows indefinite late uploads. 'false' (or not set) means no late uploads."
        }
      },
      "description": "Represents the deadline parameters for a file request.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "destination": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Destination",
      "pattern": "^/.*",
      "description": "The path in the user's Dropbox where uploaded files will be saved. Must be a path starting with '/'. Example: '/Homework/math'"
    }
  },
  "description": "Defines the parameters for creating a new file request in Dropbox."
}
```

## DROPBOX_CREATE_FOLDER
Tool to create a new folder at a specified path in Dropbox. Use when you need to organize files by creating a new directory.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateFolderRequest",
  "required": [
    "path"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "path": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Path",
      "examples": [
        "/test_folder",
        "/Documents/new_project"
      ],
      "description": "Path in the user's Dropbox to create the folder. Must start with a slash. May use 'id:' prefix for namespace-based paths. Must not end with '/' or whitespace. Paths are case-insensitive but must be correctly formatted to avoid validation errors."
    },
    "autorename": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Autorename",
      "default": false,
      "description": "If there's a conflict, have the Dropbox server try to autorename the folder to avoid the conflict. Default is False. Without autorename, a conflict returns a `path_conflict` error. For idempotent folder creation, set autorename=true or treat `path_conflict` as non-fatal."
    }
  }
}
```

## DROPBOX_CREATE_FOLDER_BATCH
Tool to create multiple folders at once in Dropbox. Use when you need to create several folders efficiently in a single request. For large batches, returns a job ID immediately and runs asynchronously; for smaller inputs, creates folders and returns results synchronously.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateFolderBatchRequest",
  "required": [
    "paths"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "paths": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Paths",
      "examples": [
        [
          "/test_folder1",
          "/test_folder2"
        ],
        [
          "/work/project1",
          "/work/project2"
        ]
      ],
      "maxItems": 10000,
      "minItems": 1,
      "description": "List of paths to be created in the user's Dropbox. Each path must start with a slash. Duplicate path arguments in the batch are considered only once. Maximum 10,000 paths."
    },
    "autorename": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Autorename",
      "default": false,
      "description": "If there's a conflict, have the Dropbox server try to autorename the folder to avoid the conflict. Default is False."
    },
    "force_async": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Force Async",
      "default": false,
      "description": "Whether to force the create to happen asynchronously. For large batches, the operation will be asynchronous automatically. Default is False."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for creating multiple folders at once."
}
```

## DROPBOX_CREATE_PAPER_DOCUMENT
Creates a new Dropbox Paper document at the specified path using HTML or Markdown content.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreatePaperDocumentRequest",
  "required": [
    "path",
    "content"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "path": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Path",
      "examples": [
        "/Paper Docs/New Doc.paper",
        "/Meeting Notes.paper"
      ],
      "description": "The fully qualified path in Dropbox where the Paper document will be created. MUST include the .paper extension at the end (e.g., '/My Documents/Notes.paper')."
    },
    "content": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Content",
      "examples": [
        "<h1>My Document</h1><p>Content here</p>"
      ],
      "description": "Content of the paper document"
    },
    "import_format": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Import Format",
      "default": "html",
      "examples": [
        "html",
        "markdown"
      ],
      "description": "Format of the provided content"
    }
  }
}
```

## DROPBOX_CREATE_PAPER_FOLDER
Tool to create a new Paper folder with the provided info. Use when you need to organize Paper documents by creating a new folder. Note: This endpoint works for content created by users on the older version of Paper.

**Input schema:**

```json
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreatePaperFolderRequest",
  "required": [
    "name"
  ],
  "properties": {

      "title": "Name",
      "examples": [
        "Test Paper Folder",
        "Meeting Notes",
        "Project Documentation"
      ],
      "description": "The name of the new Paper folder."
    },
    "is_team_folder": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Is Team Folder",
      "description": "Whether the folder to be created should be a team folder. If not specified, defaults to false."
    },
    "parent_folder_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Parent Folder Id",
      "examples": [
        "e.1234567890abcdef",
        "e.abcdef1234567890"
      ],
      "description": "The encrypted Paper folder Id where the new Paper folder should be created. If not provided, the folder will be created at the root level."
    }
  }
}
```
