## DROPBOX_CREATE_SHARED_LINK
Tool to create a stable, long-lived shared link for a Dropbox file or folder. Use when the user needs a permanent URL suitable for embedding or long-term sharing (as opposed to temporary links that expire in hours). Supports optional settings like expiration, password protection, and visibility controls. Note: If a shared link already exists for the path, the API will return an error; in that case, use a separate list_shared_links endpoint to retrieve existing links.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateSharedLinkRequest",
  "required": [
    "path"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "path": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Path",
      "examples": [
        "/Documents/report.pdf",
        "/Photos/vacation.jpg",
        "id:4g0reWVRsAAAAAAAAAAAQ",
        "rev:5f0e4d3b2a1c0000"
      ],
      "description": "The path or file identifier to be shared by the shared link. Supports Dropbox path (e.g., '/folder/file.txt'), id:..., rev:..., or ns:... notation."
    },
    "settings": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "SharedLinkSettings",
      "properties": {
        "access": {
          "enum": [
            "viewer",
            "editor"
          ],
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Access",
          "description": "The requested access level for the link. 'viewer' - Users can view and comment on content. 'editor' - Users can edit content."
        },
        "expires": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Expires",
          "examples": [
            "2026-12-31T23:59:59Z",
            "2027-01-15T12:00:00Z"
          ],
          "description": "The expiration date and time for the link in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2026-12-31T23:59:59Z'). If not set, the link will not expire."
        },
        "audience": {
          "enum": [
            "public",
            "team",
            "no_one"
          ],
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Audience",
          "description": "Who can benefit from the access level of the link. 'public' - Link is accessible by anyone. 'team' - Link is accessible by team members only. 'no_one' - The link doesn't grant access."
        },
        "link_password": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Link Password",
          "description": "The password for the link if 'require_password' is true. Only applicable when password protection is enabled for the account."
        },
        "allow_download": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Allow Download",
          "description": "Whether to allow download of the shared file or folder. If not set, defaults to true."
        },
        "require_password": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Require Password",
          "description": "Whether to require a password to access the link. If true, you must also provide 'link_password'."
        },
        "requested_visibility": {
          "enum": [
            "public",
            "team_only",
            "no_one"
          ],
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Requested Visibility",
          "description": "The requested visibility for the link. 'public' - Anyone with the link can access. 'team_only' - Only team members can access. 'no_one' - Link does not grant access. Note: This field is deprecated; use 'audience' instead for newer implementations."
        }
      },
      "description": "Settings for the shared link configuration.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for creating a shared link with settings."
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {
    "TeamInfo": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "TeamInfo",
      "required": [
        "id",
        "name"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "id": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Id",
          "description": "The team ID"
        },
        "name": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Name",
          "description": "The team name"
        }
      },
      "description": "Information about a Dropbox team."
    },
    "AudienceOption": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "AudienceOption",
      "required": [
        "audience",
        "allowed"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "allowed": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Allowed",
```

## DROPBOX_CREATE_SHARED_LINK_SIMPLE
DEPRECATED: Use CreateSharedLinkV2 instead. Tool to create a basic shared link for a Dropbox file or folder. If a shared link already exists for the given path, that link is returned. Use when you need a simple shared link without advanced settings like password protection or custom expiration. For links with advanced settings, use the create_shared_link action instead.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateSharedLinkSimpleRequest",
  "required": [
    "path"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "path": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Path",
      "examples": [
        "/Documents/report.pdf",
        "/Photos/vacation.jpg",
        "/Projects/presentation.pptx"
      ],
      "description": "The path to share. This can be a file or folder path in Dropbox (e.g., '/folder/file.txt'). If a shared link already exists for this path, that link will be returned instead of creating a new one."
    },
    "short_url": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Short Url",
      "default": false,
      "description": "Whether to return a shortened URL. If true, the returned URL will be shorter and easier to share."
    },
    "pending_upload": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "PendingUploadMode",
      "required": [
        ".tag"
      ],
      "properties": {
        ".tag": {
          "enum": [
            "file",
            "folder"
          ],
          "type": "string",
          "title": ".Tag",
          "description": "Type of pending upload. Use 'file' if the path will be a file, 'folder' if it will be a folder."
        }
      },
      "description": "Mode for pending upload indicating file or folder type.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for creating a simple shared link."
}
```

## DROPBOX_CREATE_TEAM_FOLDER
Tool to create a new, active team folder with no members in Dropbox. Use when you need to set up a new team folder for collaboration. The folder is created without any members initially.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateTeamFolderRequest",
  "required": [
    "name"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Name",
      "examples": [
        "Marketing",
        "Sales Team",
        "Engineering Docs"
      ],
      "description": "Name for the new team folder. The name must be unique within the team."
    },
    "sync_setting": {
      "enum": [
        "default",
        "not_synced"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "SyncSettingEnum",
      "description": "Sync setting enum for the team folder."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for creating a team folder."
}
```

## DROPBOX_DELETE_BATCH
Tool to delete multiple files or folders at once in Dropbox. Use when you need to delete several items simultaneously. This route is asynchronous and returns a job ID immediately for large batches. Use delete_batch/check to verify completion status.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "DropboxDeleteBatchRequest",
  "required": [
    "entries"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "entries": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "DeleteEntry",
        "required": [
          "path"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "path": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Path",
            "examples": [
              "/test_file.txt",
              "/Documents/old_report.pdf"
            ],
            "description": "Path in the user's Dropbox to delete. This path is case-sensitive."
          },
          "parent_rev": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Parent Rev",
            "description": "Perform delete if given 'rev' matches the existing file's latest 'rev'. This field does not support deleting a folder. Use this for conditional deletion to prevent race conditions."
          }
        },
        "description": "Entry specifying a file or folder to delete."
      },
      "title": "Entries",
      "examples": [
        [
          {
            "path": "/file1.txt"
          },
          {
            "path": "/folder/file2.pdf"
          }
        ]
      ],
      "maxItems": 1000,
      "description": "List of files or folders to delete. Maximum 1000 entries per request."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for batch deleting files and folders in Dropbox."
}
```

**Output schema:**

```json
          "type": "array",

              ".tag"
            ],

                "enum": [
                  "success",
                  "failure"
                ],
                "type": "string",
                "title": ".Tag",
                "description": "Indicates whether the delete operation succeeded or failed."

                "type": "object",
```

## DROPBOX_DELETE_FILE_OR_FOLDER
DEPRECATED: Use DeleteFile instead. Permanently and irreversibly deletes the file or folder at the specified path in Dropbox. Folder deletion is recursive — all nested contents are removed. Always obtain explicit user confirmation before calling, especially for folders. Requires the `files.content.write` scope.

**Input schema:**
```json

  "type": "object",
  "title": "DeleteFileOrFolderRequest",

    "path"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "path": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Path",
      "description": "The path to the file or folder to delete"

}
```

## DROPBOX_DELETE_FILE_REQUESTS
Tool to delete a batch of closed file requests in Dropbox. Use when you need to remove multiple file requests that are no longer needed. Only closed file requests can be deleted; attempting to delete open file requests will fail.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "DeleteFileRequestsRequest",
  "required": [
    "ids"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "ids": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Ids",
      "examples": [
        [
          "oaCAVmEyrqYnkZX9955Y",
          "BaZmehYoXMPtaRmfTbSG"
        ]
      ],
      "minItems": 1,
      "description": "List of file request IDs to delete. Only closed file requests can be deleted."
    }
  },
  "description": "Defines the parameters for deleting file requests."
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {

          "title": "Url",
          "format": "uri",
          "maxLength": 2083,
          "minLength": 1,
          "description": "The URL that can be shared with users to upload files to this request."

        },

              "type": "string",

                "false"
              ],
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Allow Late Uploads",
              "description": "Specifies the policy for uploads after the deadline. 'seven_days' or 'thirty_days' allows uploads for that period after the deadline. 'always' allows indefinite late uploads. 'false' (or not set) means no late uploads allowed."
            }
          },
          "description": "Details of the deadline for this file request, if one was set."
```

## DROPBOX_DELETE_MANUAL_CONTACTS_BATCH
Tool to delete specific manually added contacts from Dropbox by their email addresses. Use when you need to remove contacts that were manually added to a user's Dropbox account.

**Input schema:**
```json
{

  "title": "DeleteManualContactsBatchRequest",
  "required": [

  ],

      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Email Addresses",
      "examples": [
        [
          "test1@example.com",
          "test2@example.com"
        ],
        [
          "contact@domain.com"
        ]
      ],
      "minItems": 1,
      "description": "List of email addresses of manually added contacts to delete. Must be valid email addresses."
    },
    "dropbox_api_select_user": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Dropbox Api Select User",
      "examples": [
        "dbmid:AACzIks68_T0zljJAk8hGSmt0rLx6g5X9p0"
      ],
      "description": "Team member ID (format: dbmid:...) to specify which team member's contacts to delete. Required when using team OAuth tokens. Optional for individual accounts."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request to delete manually added contacts from Dropbox."
}
```

```json
}
```

## DROPBOX_DELETE_TEAM_GROUP
Tool to delete a Dropbox team group. Use when you need to remove a team group. Note that this requires team admin permissions and the group cannot be system-managed.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "DeleteTeamGroupRequest",
  "required": [
    "selector_type"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "group_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Group Id",
      "examples": [
        "g:e18cdeb8c1e9c0280000000000000053"
      ],
      "description": "The Dropbox group ID. Required when selector_type is 'group_id'. Example: 'g:e18cdeb8c1e9c0280000000000000053'"
    },
    "selector_type": {
      "enum": [
        "group_id",
        "group_external_id"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Selector Type",
      "examples": [
        "group_id",
        "group_external_id"
      ],
      "description": "The type of selector to use for identifying the group. 'group_id' - Select group by Dropbox group ID. 'group_external_id' - Select group by external ID."
    },
    "group_external_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Group External Id",
      "description": "The external ID of the group. Required when selector_type is 'group_external_id'. This is the ID from an external system that has been associated with the Dropbox group."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for deleting a team group."
}
```

```json
            "title": "Secondary Emails",
            "examples": [

                "bob@inst.gov"
              ]
            ],
            "minItems": 1,
            "description": "List of secondary email addresses to delete from this user. Each email must be a valid email address"
          }
        },
        "description": "User and their secondary emails to delete."
      },
      "title": "Emails To Delete",
      "minItems": 1,
      "description": "List of users and their secondary emails to delete. Each entry specifies a user and which secondary emails to remove from that user"
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for deleting secondary emails from team members."
}
```

## DROPBOX_DOWNLOAD_ZIP
Tool to download a folder from Dropbox as a zip file. Use when you need to download an entire folder structure with multiple files. The folder must be less than 20 GB in size with any single file less than 4 GB, and the resulting zip must have fewer than 10,000 total entries.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "DownloadZipRequest",
  "required": [
    "path"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "path": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Path",
      "examples": [
        "/Documents/project_files",
        "/Photos/vacation_2023",
        "/Shared/team_resources"
      ],
      "description": "The path to the folder to download as a zip file. Must be a folder path, not a single file. The folder must be less than 20 GB in size with any single file less than 4 GB. The resulting zip must have fewer than 10,000 total file and folder entries."
    }
  }
}
```

## DROPBOX_EXPORT_FILE
Tool to export non-downloadable Dropbox files (especially Dropbox Paper) to Markdown/HTML/plain text and return usable content. Use when you need to access content from files that cannot be downloaded directly, such as Dropbox Paper documents or Google Docs stored in Dropbox. Requires files.content.read scope.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ExportFileRequest",
  "required": [
    "path"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "mode": {
      "enum": [
        "return_text",
        "store_and_link"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Mode",
      "default": "return_text",
      "description": "'return_text': return exported text directly (truncated safely if very large). 'store_and_link': create a temporary Dropbox download link to the original file."
    },
    "path": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Path",
      "examples": [
        "/Documents/sample.paper",
        "/Notes/meeting.paper",
        "id:4g0reWVRsAAAAAAAAAAAQ"
      ],
      "description": "The path of the file to be exported. Supports Dropbox path (e.g., '/folder/file.paper'), id:..., rev:..., or ns:... notation. Use this for non-downloadable files like Dropbox Paper documents."
    },
    "export_format": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Export Format",
      "examples": [
        "markdown",
        "html",
        "plain_text"
      ],
      "description": "The file format to export to. Common values: 'markdown', 'html', 'plain_text'. If not specified, the default format for the file type will be used. For Dropbox Paper, default is 'markdown'."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for exporting a Dropbox file."
}
```

## DROPBOX_FILES_SEARCH
Tool to search for files and folders in Dropbox by name or content. Use when you need to find items matching a search query within a specific path or across the entire Dropbox.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "DropboxFilesSearchRequest",
  "required": [
    "query"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "mode": {
      "enum": [
        "filename",
        "filename_and_content",
        "deleted_filename"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "SearchMode",
      "default": "filename",
      "description": "Search mode for Dropbox files search."
    },
    "path": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Path",
      "default": "",
      "examples": [
        "",
        "/Documents",
        "/Photos/2024"
      ],
      "description": "The path in the user's Dropbox to search. Should probably be a folder. Use empty string to search the entire Dropbox."
    },
    "query": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Query",
      "examples": [
        "test",
        "invoice 2024",
        "report.pdf"
      ],
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "The string to search for. The search string is split on spaces into multiple tokens. For file name searching, the last token is used for prefix matching (e.g., 'bat c' matches 'bat cave' but not 'batman car')."
    },
    "start": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Start",
      "default": 0,
      "minimum": 0,
      "description": "The starting index within the search results (used for paging). Default is 0."
    },
    "max_results": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Max Results",
      "default": 100,
      "maximum": 1000,
      "minimum": 1,
      "description": "The maximum number of search results to return. Default is 100, max is 1000."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for searching files and folders in Dropbox."
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {
    "SearchMatch": {
      "type": "object",
```

## DROPBOX_FINISH_UPLOAD_SESSION
Tool to finish an upload session and save the uploaded data to the given file path. Use when completing a multi-part upload after using upload_session/start and upload_session/append. A single request should not upload more than 150 MiB. The maximum size of a file one can upload to an upload session is 2,199,019,061,248 bytes.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "FinishUploadSessionRequest",
  "required": [
    "cursor",
    "commit"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "commit": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Commit",
      "required": [
        "path"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "mode": {
          "enum": [
            "add",
            "overwrite",
            "update"
          ],
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Mode",
          "default": "add",
          "description": "Selects what to do if the file already exists. 'add' will not overwrite and use autorename if there's a conflict. 'overwrite' will always replace the existing file. 'update' will overwrite only if the given 'update_rev' matches the existing file's rev."
        },
        "mute": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Mute",
          "default": false,
          "description": "If true, this tells the clients that this modification shouldn't result in a user notification."
        },
        "path": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Path",
          "examples": [
            "/test_upload_file.txt",
            "/Documents/report.pdf",
            "/Images/photo.jpg"
          ],
          "description": "Path in the user's Dropbox to save the file. Must start with a slash."
        },
        "autorename": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Autorename",
          "default": false,
          "description": "If there's a conflict as determined by mode, have the Dropbox server try to autorename the file to avoid conflict."
        },
        "update_rev": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Update Rev",
          "description": "Required when mode is 'update'. The revision identifier of the file to update. The file will only be overwritten if this rev matches the current file's rev."
        },
        "client_modified": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Client Modified",
          "examples": [
            "2015-05-12T15:50:38Z"
          ],
          "description": "The value to store as the client_modified timestamp. Must be in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2015-05-12T15:50:38Z'). Dropbox automatically records the time at which the file was written to the Dropbox servers."
        },
        "property_groups": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "object",
            "title": "PropertyGroup",
            "required": [
              "template_id",
              "fields"
            ],
            "properties": {
              "fields": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "title": "PropertyGroupField",
                  "required": [
                    "name",
                    "value"
                  ],
                  "properties": {
                    "name": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "title": "Name",
                      "description": "The name or key of a custom property."
                    },
                    "value": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "title": "Value",
                      "description": "The value of a custom property."
                    }
                  },
                  "description": "Represents a single custom property field."
                },
                "title": "Fields",
                "description": "The property field values for this property group."
              },
              "template_id": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Template Id",
                "description": "A unique identifier for a property template type."
              }
            },
            "description": "Represents a group of custom properties."
          },
          "title": "Property Groups",
          "description": "List of custom properties to add to file."
        }
      },
      "description": "Contains the path and other optional modifiers for the commit.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "cursor": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Cursor",
      "required": [
        "session_id",
        "offset"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "offset": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "Offset",
          "minimum": 0,
          "examples": [
            0,
            1024,
            1048576
          ],
          "description": "The amount of data in bytes that has been uploaded so far. This is used to ensure upload data isn't lost or duplicated in the event of a network error."
        },
        "session_id": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Session Id",
          "examples": [
            "pid_upload_session:ABIKOafr6G6xC1dswVwcdmRsU_8LHAICxIPxvZ4W-XNJDT29uQ"
          ],
          "description": "The upload session ID returned by upload_session/start."
        }
      },
      "description": "Cursor information containing the session_id and current offset in bytes.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "content": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "FileUploadable",
      "required": [
        "name",
        "mimetype",
        "s3key"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "name": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Name",
          "examples": [
            "document.pdf",
            "image.jpg",
            "report.docx"
          ],
          "description": "The filename that will be used when uploading the file to the destination service"
        },
        "s3key": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "S3Key",
          "examples": [
            "47563/gmail/GET_ATTACHMENT/response/12345"
          ],
          "description": "The S3 key of a publicly accessible file, typically returned from a previous download action that stored the file in S3. This key references an existing file that can be uploaded to another service."
        },
        "mimetype": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Mimetype",
          "examples": [
            "application/pdf",
            "image/jpeg",
            "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document"
          ],
          "description": "The MIME type of the file"
        }
      },
      "description": "Final file data to append before finishing the session. Can be omitted if no additional data needs to be appended.",
      "file_uploadable": true,
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "local_file_path": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Local File Path",
      "examples": [
        "/tmp/final_chunk.bin",
        "/abs/path/to/data.dat"
      ],
      "description": "Absolute path to a local file containing final data to upload. If provided, the action will read raw bytes from this path. Can be omitted if no additional data needs to be appended."
    }
  }
}
```

## DROPBOX_FINISH_UPLOAD_SESSION_BATCH
Tool to commit many files at once into a user's Dropbox after uploading file contents via upload_session/start and upload_session/append. Use when you need to finish multiple upload sessions in a single request. Returns an async_job_id which can be used with upload_session/finish_batch/check to poll for completion. Maximum 1000 entries per request.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "FinishUploadSessionBatchRequest",
  "required": [
    "entries"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "entries": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "UploadSessionFinishEntry",
        "required": [
          "cursor",
          "commit"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "commit": {
            "type": "object",
            "title": "Commit",
            "required": [
              "path"
            ],
            "properties": {
              "mode": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Mode",
                "default": "add",
                "examples": [
                  "add",
                  "overwrite",
                  "update:a1c10ce0dd78"
                ],
                "description": "Selects what to do if the file already exists. 'add' will not overwrite and use autorename if there's a conflict. 'overwrite' will always replace the existing file. For 'update' mode, specify as 'update:<revision>' to provide the revision string (e.g., 'update:a1c10ce0dd78')."
              },
              "mute": {
                "type": "boolean",
                "title": "Mute",
                "default": false,
                "description": "If true, this tells the clients that this modification shouldn't result in a user notification."
              },
              "path": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Path",
                "examples": [
                  "/test_batch_upload.txt",
                  "/Documents/report.pdf",
                  "/Homework/math/Matrices.txt"
                ],
                "description": "Path in the user's Dropbox to save the file. Must start with a slash."
              },
              "autorename": {
                "type": "boolean",
                "title": "Autorename",
                "default": false,
                "description": "If there's a conflict as determined by mode, have the Dropbox server try to autorename the file to avoid conflict."
              },
              "client_modified": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Client Modified",
                "examples": [
                  "2015-05-12T15:50:38Z",
                  "2024-01-15T10:30:00Z"
                ],
                "description": "The value to store as the client_modified timestamp. Must be in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2015-05-12T15:50:38Z'). Dropbox automatically records the time at which the file was written to the Dropbox servers."
              },
              "property_groups": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "title": "PropertyGroup",
                  "required": [
                    "template_id",
                    "fields"
                  ],
                  "properties": {
                    "fields": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "object",
                        "title": "PropertyGroupField",
                        "required": [
                          "name",
                          "value"
                        ],
                        "properties": {
                          "name": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "title": "Name",
                            "description": "The name or key of a custom property."
                          },
                          "value": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "title": "Value",
                            "description": "The value of a custom property."
                          }
                        },
                        "description": "Represents a single custom property field."
                      },
                      "title": "Fields",
                      "description": "The property field values for this property group."
                    },
                    "template_id": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "title": "Template Id",
                      "description": "A unique identifier for a property template type."
                    }
                  },
                  "description": "Represents a group of custom properties."
                },
                "title": "Property Groups",
                "description": "List of custom properties to add to file."
              },
              "strict_conflict": {
                "type": "boolean",
                "title": "Strict Conflict",
                "default": false,
                "description": "If true, will check for conflicts even in 'add' mode. If a conflict is detected, the upload will fail."
              }
            },
            "description": "Contains the path and other optional modifiers for committing this file.",
            "additionalProperties": false
          },
          "cursor": {
            "type": "object",
            "title": "Cursor",
            "required": [
              "session_id",
              "offset"
            ],
            "properties": {
              "offset": {
                "type": "integer",
                "title": "Offset",
                "minimum": 0,
                "examples": [
                  0,
                  32,
                  1024,
                  1048576
                ],
                "description": "The amount of data in bytes that has been uploaded so far. Must match the size of data uploaded to the session."
              },
              "session_id": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Session Id",
                "examples": [
                  "pid_upload_session:ABIKOoKLAp1zoYo1Nh1s8Xxpl0BGpWKNPe4XH-Jqn9IUebsZQA"
                ],
                "description": "The upload session ID returned by upload_session/start or upload_session/start_batch."
              }
            },
            "description": "Cursor information containing the session_id and current offset in bytes for this upload session.",
            "additionalProperties": false
          }
        },
        "description": "Represents a single file upload session to finish."
      },
      "title": "Entries",
      "maxItems": 1000,
      "minItems": 1,
      "description": "List of upload sessions to finish. Each entry contains cursor information and commit parameters. Maximum 1000 entries per request."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request to finish multiple upload sessions at once."
}
```

**Output schema:**

```json
{

  "required": [

  "properties": {

      "title": "Data",
      "required": [
        "async_job_id"
      ],
      "properties": {

          "type": "string",
          "title": ".Tag",
          "default": "async_job_id",
          "description": "Response type tag indicating the response is an async job ID."
        },
        "async_job_id": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Async Job Id",
          "examples": [
            "pid_upload_result:ABIKOTGn3VW8UUPSFEGZIJY7TpYv-HSdyGw8Y0DBsz-jPTf8"
          ],
          "description": "Job identifier for tracking the asynchronous batch upload completion. Use this ID with upload_session/finish_batch/check to poll the job status."
        }
      },
      "description": "Data from the action execution"
    },
    "error": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Error",
```

## DROPBOX_GET_ABOUT_ME
Tool to get information about the current user's Dropbox account. Use when you need to retrieve account details like email, name, or account type. Useful for verifying authenticated account identity before destructive operations in multi-account setups. Note: successful response does not imply access to all shared or team folders; path-specific permission errors from other tools indicate missing folder-level permissions, not empty results.

```json
}
```

## DROPBOX_GET_ACCOUNT_BATCH
Tool to get information about multiple user accounts in a single request. At most 300 accounts may be queried per request. Use when you need to retrieve details for multiple Dropbox users efficiently.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "DropboxGetAccountBatchRequest",
  "required": [
    "account_ids"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "account_ids": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Account Ids",
      "examples": [
        [
          "dbid:AAAg6CG-fX-PFZBs5HJhXA9ULyesUj6f6h0"
        ],
        [
          "dbid:AAAg6CG-fX-PFZBs5HJhXA9ULyesUj6f6h0",
          "dbid:BBBh7DH-gY-QGaCt6IJiYB0VMzftVk7g7i1"
        ]
      ],
      "maxItems": 300,
      "minItems": 1,
      "description": "List of user account identifiers. Should not contain any duplicate account IDs. Maximum 300 accounts per request."
    }
  }
}
```

## DROPBOX_GET_COPY_REFERENCE
Tool to get a copy reference to a file or folder. Use when you need to generate a reference string that can be used to copy the file or folder to another user's Dropbox via copy_reference/save.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetCopyReferenceRequest",
  "required": [
    "path"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "path": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Path",
      "examples": [
        "/test.txt",
        "/Documents/report.pdf",
        "/Photos/Vacation"
      ],
      "description": "The path to the file or folder you want to get a copy reference to. This path is case-sensitive."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for getting a copy reference to a file or folder."
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {

        "copy_reference",
        "expires",
        "metadata"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "expires": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Expires",
          "format": "date-time",
          "description": "The expiration date and time of the copy reference. After this time, the reference will no longer be valid."
        },
        "metadata": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "Metadata",
          "description": "Metadata for the file or folder that the copy reference points to.",
          "additionalProperties": true
        },
        "copy_reference": {

          "title": "Copy Reference",
          "description": "A token that can be used to copy the file or folder to another user's Dropbox by passing it to copy_reference/save."
        }
      },
      "description": "Response model for the get copy reference action.\nContains the copy reference string and metadata."
    }
  },

  ],
```

## DROPBOX_GET_FILE_LOCK_BATCH
Tool to return lock metadata for multiple files in a single batch request. Use when you need to check the lock status of up to 1000 files at once.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetFileLockBatchRequest",
  "required": [
    "entries"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "entries": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "PathArg",
        "required": [
          "path"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "path": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Path",
            "examples": [
              "/test.txt",
              "/Documents/report.pdf",
              "id:4g0reWVRsAAAAAAAAAAAQ"
            ],
            "description": "The path to the file you want to check lock status for. Must be a valid Dropbox path starting with '/' or a file ID."
          }
        },
        "description": "Path specification for a file to check lock status."
      },
      "title": "Entries",
      "maxItems": 1000,
      "minItems": 1,
      "description": "List of files to check lock status for. Maximum 1000 entries per request."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for getting file locks in batch."
}
```

## DROPBOX_GET_FILE_METADATA_BATCH
Tool to retrieve metadata for multiple shared files in a single batch request. Use when you need to get information about shared file permissions, access levels, owners, and sharing policies for multiple files at once.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetFileMetadataBatchRequest",
  "required": [
    "files"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "files": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Files",
      "examples": [
        [
          "/Documents/report.pdf",
          "/Photos/image.png"
        ],
        [
          "id:7bh4zBmgZoAAAAAAAAAAFg",
          "id:8ci5zCnhApBBBBBBBBBBBh"
        ]
      ],
      "maxItems": 100,
      "minItems": 1,
      "description": "List of files to query. Each can be a file ID (e.g., 'id:7bh4zBmgZoAAAAAAAAAAFg') or a path (e.g., '/path/to/file.txt'). Maximum 100 files per request."
    },
    "actions": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "FileAction",
        "required": [
          ".tag"
        ],
        "properties": {
          ".tag": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": ".Tag",
            "description": "The type of action (e.g., 'disable_viewer_info', 'edit_contents', 'enable_viewer_info', 'invite_viewer', 'invite_viewer_no_comment', 'unshare', 'relinquish_membership', 'create_link')."
          }
        },
        "description": "Represents a file action that can be performed."
      },
      "title": "Actions",
      "description": "A list of FileActions corresponding to FilePermissions that should appear in the response's permissions field describing the actions the authenticated user can perform on the files."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for getting shared file metadata in batch."
}
```

## DROPBOX_GET_FILE_PREVIEW
Tool to get a preview for a file. PDF previews are generated for document formats (.ai, .doc, .docx, .eps, .ppt, .pptx, etc.), and HTML previews are generated for spreadsheet formats (.csv, .xls, .xlsx, etc.). Use when you need to view file content without downloading the original file. Returns error for unsupported file types.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetFilePreviewRequest",
  "required": [
    "path"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "path": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Path",
      "examples": [
        "/Documents/report.docx",
        "/Spreadsheets/data.csv",
        "/Presentations/slides.pptx"
      ],
      "description": "The path of the file to preview. Supported preview formats: PDF previews (.ai, .doc, .docm, .docx, .eps, .gdoc, .gslides, .odp, .odt, .pps, .ppsm, .ppsx, .ppt, .pptm, .pptx, .rtf); HTML previews (.csv, .ods, .xls, .xlsm, .gsheet, .xlsx)."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for getting file preview."
}
```

## DROPBOX_GET_FILE_TAGS
Tool to get list of tags assigned to files or folders in Dropbox. Use when you need to retrieve tags for one or more items. This endpoint does not support apps with the app folder permission.

```json
      },
      "title": "Paths",
      "examples": [

          "/test.txt"
        ],
        [
          "/Documents/report.pdf",
          "/Photos"
        ]
      ],
      "maxItems": 1000,
      "minItems": 1,
      "description": "List of file or folder paths to get tags for (e.g., [\"/Documents/report.pdf\", \"/Photos/image.jpg\"]). Maximum of 1000 paths per request."
```

## DROPBOX_GET_FOLDER_CURSOR
Tool to get a cursor representing the current state of a folder without listing its contents. Use when you only need to track future changes to a folder, not retrieve existing files. This is more efficient than list_folder for setting up change monitoring or sync functionality.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetFolderCursorRequest",
  "properties": {
    "path": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Path",
      "default": "",
      "examples": [
        "",
        "/Documents",
        "/Photos/Vacation",
        "id:abc123xyz"
      ],
      "description": "The path to the folder. Use \"\" (empty string) for the root folder, or a path like \"/folder/subfolder\". Also accepts folder IDs (e.g., \"id:abc123xyz\")."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "maximum": 2000,
      "minimum": 1,
      "description": "The maximum number of results to return per request when using this cursor with list_folder/continue. If not specified, the API uses a default."
    },
    "recursive": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Recursive",
      "default": false,
      "description": "If true, the cursor will include all subfolders and their contents recursively. If false, only the immediate contents are tracked."
    },
    "shared_link": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "SharedLink",
      "required": [
        "url"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "url": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Url",
          "examples": [
            "https://www.dropbox.com/s/abc123/folder"
          ],
          "description": "Shared link URL to list the contents of."
        },
        "password": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Password",
          "description": "Password for the shared link, if it is password-protected."
        }
      },
      "description": "Shared link information for listing folder contents.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "include_deleted": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Include Deleted",
      "default": false,
      "description": "If true, deleted files and folders will be included when using this cursor to track changes."
    },
    "include_media_info": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Include Media Info",
      "default": false,
      "description": "If true, media metadata (dimensions, location, etc.) will be included for photo and video files when using this cursor."
    },
    "include_mounted_folders": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Include Mounted Folders",
      "default": true,
      "description": "If true, results will include entries under mounted folders (app folders, shared folders, team folders)."
    },
    "include_property_groups": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "PropertyGroupTemplate",
      "required": [
        ".tag"
      ],
      "properties": {
        ".tag": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": ".Tag",
          "description": "Type of template filter (filter_some or other)."
        },
        "filter_some": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "title": "Filter Some",
          "description": "List of template IDs to include in property groups."
        }
      },
      "description": "Template filter for property groups.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "include_has_explicit_shared_members": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Include Has Explicit Shared Members",
      "default": false,
      "description": "If true, results will include a flag indicating whether each file or folder has explicit shared members."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for getting a folder cursor."
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {
    "GetFolderCursorResponse": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "GetFolderCursorResponse",
      "required": [
        "cursor"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "cursor": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Cursor",
          "description": "A cursor string that represents the current state of the folder. Use this with /files/list_folder/continue to retrieve changes since this point."
        }
      },
      "description": "Response containing the folder state cursor."
    }

    "successful"
  ],

      ],

      "type": "string",

    },

      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Successful",

    }
  }
}
```

```json
              "y": {

              },
              "crv": {

                "title": "Crv",
                "description": "Curve name for Elliptic Curve keys, e.g., 'P-256'. Present for EC keys."
              },
              "kid": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Kid",
                "description": "Key ID, a unique identifier for this key used to match keys with tokens."
              },
              "kty": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Kty",
                "description": "Key type, typically 'RSA' for RSA keys or 'EC' for Elliptic Curve keys."
              },
              "use": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Use",
                "description": "Intended use of the key, typically 'sig' for signature verification or 'enc' for encryption."
              }
            },
            "description": "Represents a single JSON Web Key in the JWKS."
          },
          "title": "Keys",
          "description": "Array of JSON Web Keys containing public verification keys for signed ID tokens."
        }
      },
      "description": "Data from the action execution"
    },
    "error": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Error",
      "description": "Error if any occurred during the execution of the action"
    },
    "successful": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Successful",
      "description": "Whether or not the action execution was successful or not"
    }
  }
}
```

## DROPBOX_GET_METADATA
Tool to fetch metadata for a file or folder by path. Use when you need to verify existence, get canonical identifiers (id, path_display), determine type (.tag), or retrieve detailed attributes without enumerating folder contents.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetMetadataRequest",
  "required": [
    "path"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "path": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Path",
      "examples": [
        "/Documents/report.pdf",
        "/Photos"
      ],
      "description": "The path of a file or folder on Dropbox (e.g., \"/Documents/report.pdf\"). Note: The root folder (\"\" or \"/\") is not supported by this endpoint."
    },
    "include_deleted": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Include Deleted",
      "default": false,
      "description": "If true, DeletedMetadata will be returned for deleted files or folders. Otherwise, deleted items will return an error."
    },
    "include_media_info": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Include Media Info",
      "default": false,
      "description": "If true, FileMetadata.media_info is set for photo and video files, providing additional metadata like dimensions and location."
    },
    "include_has_explicit_shared_members": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Include Has Explicit Shared Members",
      "default": false,
      "description": "If true, the result will include a flag indicating whether the file has any explicit shared members."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for fetching metadata."
}
```

## DROPBOX_GET_METADATA_ALPHA
Tool to fetch metadata for a file or folder using the alpha endpoint. Use when you need metadata with advanced property filtering or custom property template support.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetMetadataAlphaRequest",
  "required": [
    "path"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "path": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Path",
      "examples": [
        "/Documents/report.pdf",
        "/Photos",
        "/test.txt"
      ],
      "description": "The path of a file or folder on Dropbox (e.g., \"/Documents/report.pdf\"). Use \"\" or \"/\" for the root folder."
    },
    "include_deleted": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Include Deleted",
      "default": false,
      "description": "If true, DeletedMetadata will be returned for deleted files or folders. Otherwise, deleted items will return an error."
    },
    "include_media_info": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Include Media Info",
      "default": false,
      "description": "If true, FileMetadata.media_info is set for photo and video files, providing additional metadata like dimensions and location."
    },
    "include_property_groups": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "TemplateFilterBase",
      "required": [
        ".tag"
      ],
      "properties": {
        ".tag": {
          "enum": [
            "filter_some",
            "other"
          ],
          "type": "string",
          "title": ".Tag",
          "description": "Type of template filter. Use 'filter_some' to specify template IDs, or 'other' for no filtering."
        },
        "filter_some": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "title": "Filter Some",
          "description": "List of template IDs to filter by. Only used when tag is 'filter_some'."
        }
      },
      "description": "Filter for property template IDs.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "include_has_explicit_shared_members": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Include Has Explicit Shared Members",
      "default": false,
      "description": "If true, the result will include a flag indicating whether the file has any explicit shared members."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for fetching metadata using the alpha endpoint."
}
```

```json
                            }

                        },
                        "title": "Fields",

            {
              "type": "object",
              "title": "DeletedMetadata",
              "required": [

                "name"
              ],
              "properties": {
                "id": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "title": "Id",
                  "description": "A unique identifier for the deleted file or folder. May be null."
                },
                ".tag": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "const": "deleted",
                  "title": ".Tag",
                  "description": "Type tag indicating this item is deleted."
                },
                "name": {

                  "title": "Name",
                  "description": "The last component of the path."

                "path_display": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "title": "Path Display",
                  "description": "The cased path to be used for display purposes only. May be null for deleted items."
                }

              "description": "Metadata for a deleted file or folder."

      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Successful",
      "description": "Whether or not the action execution was successful or not"
    }
  }
}
```

## DROPBOX_GET_SHARED_FILE_METADATA
Tool to retrieve metadata for a shared file in Dropbox. Use when you need to get information about a shared file's permissions, access levels, owner, and sharing policies.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetSharedFileMetadataRequest",
  "required": [
    "file"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "file": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "File",
      "examples": [
        "id:7bh4zBmgZoAAAAAAAAAAFg",
        "/path/to/file.txt"
      ],
      "description": "The file to query. Can be a file ID (e.g., 'id:7bh4zBmgZoAAAAAAAAAAFg') or a path."
    },
    "actions": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "FileAction",
        "required": [
          ".tag"
        ],
        "properties": {
          ".tag": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": ".Tag",
            "description": "The type of action (e.g., 'disable_viewer_info', 'edit_contents', 'enable_viewer_info', 'invite_viewer', 'invite_viewer_no_comment', 'unshare', 'relinquish_membership', 'create_link')."
          }
        },
        "description": "Represents a file action that can be performed."
      },
      "title": "Actions",
      "description": "A list of FileActions corresponding to FilePermissions that should appear in the response's permissions field describing the actions the authenticated user can perform on the file."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for getting shared file metadata."
}
```

## DROPBOX_GET_SHARED_FOLDER_METADATA
Tool to retrieve metadata for a specific shared folder by its ID. Use when you need detailed information about a shared folder including access level, policies, owner, paths, and permissions.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetSharedFolderMetadataRequest",
  "required": [
    "shared_folder_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "actions": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "FolderAction",
        "required": [
          ".tag"
        ],
        "properties": {
          ".tag": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": ".Tag",
            "description": "Folder action type (e.g., 'change_options', 'edit_contents', 'invite_editor', 'invite_viewer', 'leave_a_copy', 'share_link', 'create_link', 'unshare')"
          }
        }
      },
      "title": "Actions",
      "description": "A list of FolderActions corresponding to FolderPermissions that should appear in the response's permissions field describing the actions the authenticated user can perform on the folder"
    },
    "shared_folder_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Shared Folder Id",
      "examples": [
        "84528192421",
        "13512984419"
      ],
      "description": "The ID for the shared folder"
    }
  }
}
```

## DROPBOX_GET_SHARED_LINK_FILE
Tool to download a file from a Dropbox shared link. Use when you have a shared link URL and need to retrieve the actual file content. This endpoint works with shared links to files; for shared links to folders, use the path parameter to specify which file within the folder to download.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetSharedLinkFileRequest",
  "required": [
    "url"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "url": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Url",
      "examples": [
        "https://www.dropbox.com/s/2sn712vy1ovegw8/Prime_Numbers.txt?dl=0",
        "https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fi/5qnoiq0sb4bra3mwwpsfs/test.txt?rlkey=v2ld1w6kc7wimjf55uqjloz3t&dl=0"
      ],
      "description": "URL of the shared link to download the file from."
    },
    "path": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Path",
      "examples": [
        "/subfolder/file.txt",
        "/document.pdf"
      ],
      "description": "If the shared link is to a folder, this parameter can be used to retrieve a specific file or sub-folder in this folder. Path must start with '/'."
    },
    "link_password": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Link Password",
      "description": "If the shared link has a password, this parameter can be used to provide it."
    }
  }
}
```

## DROPBOX_GET_SHARED_LINK_METADATA
Tool to resolve a Dropbox shared link URL into structured metadata. Use when the user provides a shared link and you need to determine what it points to (file vs folder) and obtain canonical identifiers (id, path) to enable follow-on operations.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetSharedLinkMetadataRequest",
  "required": [
    "url"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "url": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Url",
      "examples": [
        "https://www.dropbox.com/s/2sn712vy1ovegw8/Prime_Numbers.txt?dl=0",
        "https://www.dropbox.com/sh/abcdefg1234567/AABBccDDeeFFgg?dl=0"
      ],
      "description": "The shared link URL to retrieve metadata for."
    },
    "path": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Path",
      "examples": [
        "/subfolder",
        "/file.txt",
        "/docs/report.pdf"
      ],
      "description": "If the shared link is to a folder, this parameter can be used to retrieve metadata for a specific file or sub-folder in this folder. A relative path should be used."
    },
    "link_password": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Link Password",
      "description": "If the shared link has a password, this parameter can be used to provide it."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for getting shared link metadata."
}
```

## DROPBOX_GET_SPACE_USAGE
Tool to get space usage information for the current user's Dropbox account. Use when you need to check storage usage, available space, or quota information.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetSpaceUsageRequest",
  "properties": {},
  "description": "Request model for getting space usage. This endpoint requires no parameters."
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",

          "description": "The team's total space usage (bytes)."

          "type": "integer",
```

## DROPBOX_GET_TEAM_GROUPS_JOB_STATUS
Tool to check the status of an asynchronous team groups job in Dropbox. Use when you have an async_job_id from a previous team groups operation (like groups_delete) and need to poll its completion status.

**Input schema:**
```json

  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetTeamGroupsJobStatusRequest",
  "required": [
    "async_job_id"

  "properties": {

      "type": "string",
      "title": "Async Job Id",
      "examples": [
        "dbjid:AABqMA6RIxE3E6A"
      ],
      "description": "Id of the asynchronous job. This is the value of a response returned from the method that launched the job (e.g., from team_groups_delete)."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for checking the status of an asynchronous team groups job."
}
```

```json
        ".tag"
      ],
      "properties": {
        ".tag": {
          "enum": [

            "invalid_async_job_id",

      "description": "Response from checking the status of an asynchronous team groups job.\nThe tag field indicates the current status or error type."
```

## DROPBOX_GET_TEAM_MEMBER_CUSTOM_QUOTA
Tool to retrieve custom storage quotas for team members. Use when you need to check which team members have custom quota allocations and their quota amounts. Requires team admin credentials.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetTeamMemberCustomQuotaRequest",
  "properties": {
    "users": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "UserSelectorArg",
        "required": [
          ".tag"
        ],
        "properties": {
          ".tag": {
            "enum": [
              "team_member_id",
              "external_id",
              "email"
            ],
            "type": "string",
            "title": ".Tag",
            "description": "Type of identifier being used to select the user. Must be one of: 'team_member_id', 'external_id', or 'email'."
          },
          "email": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Email",
            "examples": [
              "user@company.com"
            ],
            "description": "The email address of the user. Use this when you only have the user's email address."
          },
          "external_id": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "External Id",
            "description": "The external ID of the user. Use this when identifying users via an external system's identifier."
          },
          "team_member_id": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Team Member Id",
            "examples": [
              "dbmid:AACwJ2ojytbXGFyiUs6_0Py3GqOt2LyicSg"
            ],
            "description": "The team member ID of the user. Use this when you have the user's unique team member identifier."
          }
        },
        "description": "Argument for selecting a single user by team_member_id, external_id, or email.\nExactly one of the identifier fields must be provided."
      },
      "title": "Users",
      "examples": [
        [
          {
            ".tag": "team_member_id",
            "team_member_id": "dbmid:AACwJ2ojytbXGFyiUs6_0Py3GqOt2LyicSg"
          }
        ]
      ],
      "maxItems": 1000,
      "description": "List of team member identifiers to retrieve custom quota for. Each member must be identified by exactly one of: team_member_id, external_id, or email. Maximum of 1000 users per request. An empty list returns all users with custom quotas."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for getting custom storage quota for team members."
}
```

## DROPBOX_GET_TEAM_MEMBERS_ADD_JOB_STATUS
Tool to poll the status of an asynchronous team member addition job. Use when you have an async_job_id from team/members/add_v2 and need to check if the member addition has completed. Returns 'in_progress', 'complete' with per-member results, or 'failed' with error details.

```json
      ],
      "description": "Id of the asynchronous job returned from team/members/add_v2. This is used to poll the status of the asynchronous request."

}
```

## DROPBOX_GET_TEMPORARY_LINK
Tool to get a one-click temporary (expiring) download link. Use when you need to share a Dropbox file directly without proxying content through this service. Only works for files, not folders. Returned URLs expire within hours and must be regenerated for future use; never treat them as permanent links. Requires `files.content.read` scope.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetTemporaryLinkRequest",
  "required": [
    "path"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "path": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Path",
      "examples": [
        "/Homework/math/Prime_Numbers.txt",
        "id:4g0reWVRsAAAAAAAAAAAQ",
        "rev:5f0e4d3b2a1c0000",
        "ns:12345/Photos/Vacation.jpg"
      ],
      "description": "The path or identifier of the file to get a temporary link for. Supports Dropbox path (e.g., '/folder/file.txt'), id:..., rev:..., or ns:... notation."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for the /2/files/get_temporary_link endpoint."
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {
    "MediaInfo": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "MediaInfo",
      "required": [
        ".tag"
      ],
      "properties": {
        ".tag": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": ".Tag",
          "description": "Type of media metadata: 'pending' (processing) or 'metadata' (available)."
        },
        "duration": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "Duration",
          "minimum": 0,
          "description": "Video duration in milliseconds (present when tag='metadata' and type is video)."
        },
        "location": {
          "type": "object",
```

## DROPBOX_GET_TEMPORARY_UPLOAD_LINK
Tool to get a one-time use temporary upload link to upload a file to Dropbox. Use when you need to perform a delayed upload where the file will be uploaded to the returned link via POST with Content-Type: application/octet-stream. The upload link is valid for up to 4 hours.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetTemporaryUploadLinkRequest",
  "required": [
    "commit_info"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "duration": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Duration",
      "default": 3600,
      "maximum": 14400,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        3600,
        7200,
        14400
      ],
      "description": "Link validity period in seconds. Maximum is 4 hours (14400 seconds)."
    },
    "commit_info": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Commit Info",
      "required": [
        "path"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "rev": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Rev",
          "examples": [
            "a1c10ce0dd78",
            "015f87a61234567890abcdef"
          ],
          "description": "File revision ID (required when mode is 'update'). Must be at least 9 characters matching pattern [0-9a-f]+."
        },
        "mode": {
          "enum": [
            "add",
            "overwrite",
            "update"
          ],
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Mode",
          "default": "add",
          "examples": [
            "add",
            "overwrite",
            "update"
          ],
          "description": "Upload mode: 'add' creates a new file, 'overwrite' replaces existing file, 'update' updates specific revision (requires rev parameter)."
        },
        "mute": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Mute",
          "default": false,
          "description": "If true, the user will not be notified of the new file via desktop or mobile notifications."
        },
        "path": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Path",
          "examples": [
            "/Homework/math/Matrices.txt",
            "/test_upload_file.txt",
            "/Documents/report.pdf"
          ],
          "description": "Path in the user's Dropbox where the file will be saved."
        },
        "autorename": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Autorename",
          "default": false,
          "description": "If true and a file already exists at the path, the new file will be renamed to avoid conflict."
        },
        "strict_conflict": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Strict Conflict",
          "default": false,
          "description": "If true, the upload will be rejected if the file already exists."
        }
      },
      "description": "Upload configuration specifying destination path and upload behavior.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for getting a temporary upload link."
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {
    "GetTemporaryUploadLinkResponse": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "GetTemporaryUploadLinkResponse",
      "required": [
        "link"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "link": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Link",
          "examples": [
            "https://content.dropboxapi.com/apitul/1/bNi2uIYF51cVBND"
          ],
          "description": "Temporary upload URL valid for up to 4 hours. Use this URL to POST file data with Content-Type: application/octet-stream."
        }
      },
      "description": "Response model containing the temporary upload link."
    }
  },
  "title": "GetTemporaryUploadLinkResponseWrapper",
  "required": [
    "data",
    "successful"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "data": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Data",
      "required": [
        "link"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "link": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Link",
          "examples": [
            "https://content.dropboxapi.com/apitul/1/bNi2uIYF51cVBND"
          ],
          "description": "Temporary upload URL valid for up to 4 hours. Use this URL to POST file data with Content-Type: application/octet-stream."
        }
      },
      "description": "Data from the action execution"
    },
    "error": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Error",
      "description": "Error if any occurred during the execution of the action"
    },
    "successful": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Successful",
      "description": "Whether or not the action execution was successful or not"
    }
  }
}
```

## DROPBOX_GET_THUMBNAIL
Tool to get a thumbnail for an image file. Use when you need to generate a thumbnail preview of an image. Supports jpg, jpeg, png, tiff, tif, gif, webp, ppm, and bmp files under 20MB.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetThumbnailRequest",
  "required": [
    "path"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "mode": {
      "enum": [
        "strict",
        "bestfit",
        "fitone_bestfit"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Mode",
      "default": "strict",
      "description": "How to resize and crop the image. 'strict': scale down to fit within the given size. 'bestfit': scale down to fit within size or its transpose. 'fitone_bestfit': scale down to completely cover size or its transpose."
    },
    "path": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Path",
      "examples": [
        "/Photos/vacation.jpg",
        "/Images/screenshot.png"
      ],
      "description": "The path to the image file you want to thumbnail. Must start with '/'."
    },
    "size": {
      "enum": [
        "w32h32",
        "w64h64",
        "w128h128",
        "w256h256",
        "w480h320",
        "w640h480",
        "w960h640",
        "w1024h768",
        "w2048h1536"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Size",
      "default": "w64h64",
      "description": "The size for the thumbnail image. Options range from 32x32 pixels to 2048x1536 pixels."
    },
    "format": {
      "enum": [
        "jpeg",
        "png"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Format",
      "default": "jpeg",
      "description": "The format for the thumbnail image. Use 'jpeg' for photos (default), 'png' for screenshots and digital arts."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for getting a thumbnail for an image file."
}
```

## DROPBOX_GET_THUMBNAIL_BATCH
Tool to get thumbnails for multiple image files in a single batch request. Use when you need to generate thumbnail previews for up to 25 images at once. Supports jpg, jpeg, png, tiff, tif, gif, webp, ppm, and bmp files under 20MB.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetThumbnailBatchRequest",
  "required": [
    "entries"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "entries": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "ThumbnailArg",
        "required": [
          "path"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "mode": {
            "enum": [
              "strict",
              "bestfit",
              "fitone_bestfit"
            ],
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Mode",
            "default": "strict",
            "description": "How to resize and crop the image. 'strict': scale to fit exactly. 'bestfit': scale to fit or transpose if needed. 'fitone_bestfit': scale to cover with transpose if needed."
          },
          "path": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Path",
            "examples": [
              "/Photos/vacation.jpg",
              "/Images/screenshot.png"
            ],
            "description": "The path to the image file you want to thumbnail. Must be a valid Dropbox path starting with '/'."
          },
          "size": {
            "enum": [
              "w32h32",
              "w64h64",
              "w128h128",
              "w256h256",
              "w480h320",
              "w640h480",
              "w960h640",
              "w1024h768",
              "w2048h1536"
            ],
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Size",
            "default": "w64h64",
            "description": "The size for the thumbnail image. Options range from 32x32 pixels to 2048x1536 pixels."
          },
          "format": {
            "enum": [
              "jpeg",
              "png"
            ],
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Format",
            "default": "jpeg",
            "description": "The format for the thumbnail image. Use 'jpeg' for photos, 'png' for screenshots and digital arts."
          }
        },
        "description": "Parameters for requesting a thumbnail of a single file."
      },
      "title": "Entries",
      "maxItems": 25,
      "minItems": 1,
      "description": "List of files to get thumbnails for. Maximum 25 entries per request."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for getting thumbnails in batch."
}
```

**Output schema:**

## DROPBOX_GET_THUMBNAIL_V2
Tool to get a thumbnail for an image file. Use when you need to generate a thumbnail preview of an image. Supports jpg, jpeg, png, tiff, tif, gif, webp, ppm, and bmp files under 20MB. Can access files via direct path or shared link.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetThumbnailV2Request",
  "required": [
    "resource_type"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "url": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Url",
      "examples": [
        "https://www.dropbox.com/s/abc123/image.jpg?dl=0"
      ],
      "description": "The shared link URL (required when resource_type is 'link')."
    },
    "mode": {
      "enum": [
        "strict",
        "bestfit",
        "fitone_bestfit"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Mode",
      "default": "strict",
      "description": "How to resize and crop the image. 'strict': scale down to fit within the given size. 'bestfit': scale down to fit within size or its transpose. 'fitone_bestfit': scale down to completely cover size or its transpose."
    },
    "path": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Path",
      "examples": [
        "/Photos/vacation.jpg",
        "/Images/screenshot.png"
      ],
      "description": "The path to the image file (required when resource_type is 'path'). Must start with '/'."
    },
    "size": {
      "enum": [
        "w32h32",
        "w64h64",
        "w128h128",
        "w256h256",
        "w480h320",
        "w640h480",
        "w960h640",
        "w1024h768",
        "w2048h1536"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Size",
      "default": "w64h64",
      "description": "The size for the thumbnail image. Options range from 32x32 pixels to 2048x1536 pixels."
    },
    "format": {
      "enum": [
        "jpeg",
        "png"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Format",
      "default": "jpeg",
      "description": "The format for the thumbnail image. Use 'jpeg' for photos, 'png' for screenshots and digital arts."
    },
    "link_path": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Link Path",
      "description": "Optional relative path within shared folder (only used with resource_type='link' when link points to a folder)."
    },
    "resource_type": {
      "enum": [
        "path",
        "link"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Resource Type",
      "description": "Type of resource: 'path' for direct file path or 'link' for shared link."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for getting a thumbnail for an image file."
}
```

## DROPBOX_GET_USER_FEATURES
Tool to get a list of feature values configured for the current Dropbox account. Use when you need to check which features are enabled, such as paper_as_files or file_locking.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "DropboxGetUserFeaturesRequest",
  "required": [
    "features"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "features": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "UserFeature",
        "required": [
          ".tag"
        ],
        "properties": {
          ".tag": {
            "enum": [
              "paper_as_files",
              "file_locking"
            ],
            "type": "string",
            "title": ".Tag",
            "examples": [
              "paper_as_files",
              "file_locking"
            ],
            "description": "The feature identifier. 'paper_as_files' indicates how Paper files are stored. 'file_locking' indicates if users can lock files to restrict editing."
          }
        }
      },
      "title": "Features",
      "examples": [
        [
          {
            "tag": "paper_as_files"
          },
          {
            "tag": "file_locking"
          }
        ]
      ],
      "minItems": 1,
      "description": "A list of features to get values for. Available features: 'paper_as_files' (information about how Paper files are stored), 'file_locking' (whether users can lock files in shared directories)."
    }
  }
}
```
