## DROPBOX_LIST_FILE_MEMBERS
Tool to obtain the members who have been invited to a file, both inherited and uninherited members. Use when you need to retrieve detailed information about users, groups, and invitees with access to a specific file, including their access levels and permissions.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListFileMembersRequest",
  "required": [
    "file"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "file": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "File",
      "examples": [
        "id:3kmLmQFnf1AAAAAAAAAAAw",
        "/Documents/report.pdf"
      ],
      "description": "The file for which you want to see members. Can be a file ID (starting with 'id:') or a file path (starting with '/')."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "default": 100,
      "maximum": 300,
      "minimum": 1,
      "description": "Number of members to return max per query. Must be between 1 and 300."
    },
    "actions": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Actions",
      "examples": [
        [
          "make_editor",
          "remove"
        ],
        [
          "make_viewer"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "The actions for which to return permissions on a member. Valid values: 'leave_a_copy', 'make_editor', 'make_owner', 'make_viewer', 'make_viewer_no_comment', 'remove'."
    },
    "include_inherited": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Include Inherited",
      "default": true,
      "description": "Whether to include members who only have access from a parent shared folder. Defaults to true."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for listing file members."
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {
```

## DROPBOX_LIST_FILE_MEMBERS_BATCH
Tool to get members of multiple files at once. Use when you need to retrieve sharing information for multiple files in a single request. Returns users, groups, and invitees with access to each file, but does not include inherited members or detailed permissions. For more detailed results, use the individual file member endpoint.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListFileMembersBatchRequest",
  "required": [
    "files"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "files": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Files",
      "examples": [
        [
          "id:abc123xyz",
          "/Documents/report.pdf"
        ],
        [
          "/Photos/vacation.jpg",
          "/Notes/meeting.txt"
        ]
      ],
      "maxItems": 100,
      "minItems": 1,
      "description": "Files for which to return members. Can be file IDs (starting with 'id:') or paths (starting with '/'). Maximum 100 files per request."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "default": 10,
      "maximum": 20,
      "minimum": 1,
      "description": "Number of members to return max per query per file. Defaults to 10 if not specified. Maximum 20."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for listing file members in batch."
}
```

## DROPBOX_LIST_FILE_REQUESTS_CONTINUE
Tool to paginate through file requests using a cursor from a previous list call. Use when you have a cursor from /2/file_requests/list or /2/file_requests/list/continue and need to retrieve the next batch of file requests.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListFileRequestsContinueRequest",
  "required": [
    "cursor"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "cursor": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Cursor",
      "examples": [
        "ZtkX9_EHj3x7PMkVuFIhwKYXEpwpLwyxp9vMKomUhllil9q7eWiAu"
      ],
      "description": "The cursor returned by a previous call to list file requests. This cursor is used to paginate through all file requests. Must come from a previous call to /2/file_requests/list or /2/file_requests/list/continue."
    }
  },

}
```

## DROPBOX_LIST_FILE_REVISIONS
Tool to retrieve the revision history for a file. Use when you need to see past versions of a file, restore a previous version, or track changes over time.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListFileRevisionsRequest",
  "required": [
    "path"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "mode": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "ListRevisionsMode",
      "required": [
        ".tag"
      ],
      "properties": {
        ".tag": {
          "enum": [
            "path",
            "id"
          ],
          "type": "string",
          "title": ".Tag",
          "description": "Determines the behavior of the API in listing revisions. 'path' returns revisions with the same file path as identified by the latest file entry at the given file path or id. 'id' returns revisions with the same file id as identified by the latest file entry at the given file path or id."
        }
      },
      "description": "Mode for listing revisions.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "path": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Path",
      "examples": [
        "/Documents/report.pdf",
        "/Photos/image.jpg"
      ],
      "description": "The path to the file you want to see the revisions of (e.g., \"/Documents/report.pdf\"). Must be a valid file path in Dropbox."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "default": 10,
      "maximum": 100,
      "minimum": 1,
      "description": "The maximum number of revision entries returned. Default is 10, minimum is 1, maximum is 100."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for listing file revisions."
}
```

## DROPBOX_LIST_FILES_IN_FOLDER
Tool to list files and folders in a specified Dropbox directory. Use when you need to see the contents of a folder, including subfolders if recursive is true. When the response contains `has_more=true`, continue fetching with the returned cursor until `has_more=false` — stopping early misses entries in large folders. Response entries include both files and folders; use the `.tag` field on each entry to distinguish item types.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListFilesInFolderRequest",
  "properties": {
    "path": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Path",
      "default": "",
      "description": "The folder path (e.g., \"/europe/invoices\") or folder ID (e.g., \"id:aBcDeFgH123\") to list contents from. Use \"\" (empty string) for the root folder. No trailing slashes or whitespace allowed \u2014 malformed paths can silently produce empty results. Prefer paths from `path_display` or `path_lower` fields in prior API responses over manually constructed paths."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "default": 2000,
      "maximum": 2000,
      "minimum": 1,
      "description": "The maximum number of results to return per request. Default is 2000. Max is 2000."
    },
    "recursive": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Recursive",
      "default": false,
      "description": "If true, recursively lists contents of nested subfolders; otherwise, lists only immediate contents. Large or broad folder trees with recursive=true can produce very large responses and high latency; use only when full hierarchy is explicitly needed."
    },
    "include_deleted": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Include Deleted",
      "default": false,
      "description": "If true, includes deleted (but potentially recoverable) files and folders in the listing."
    },
    "include_media_info": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Include Media Info",
      "default": false,
      "description": "If true, includes media metadata (e.g., dimensions, location) for photo and video files."
    },
    "include_non_downloadable_files": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Include Non Downloadable Files",
      "default": true,
      "description": "If true, includes non-downloadable files (e.g., Google Docs, Dropbox Paper) in the listing."
    }
  }
}
```

## DROPBOX_LIST_FOLDER_CONTINUE
Tool to continue paginating through folder contents using a cursor from list_folder. Use when has_more is true to retrieve remaining entries.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListFolderContinueRequest",
  "required": [
    "cursor"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "cursor": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Cursor",
      "examples": [
        "AAWsOGXU6H705i0I1jA5IsM2u5KdJlN1AxdCAO2gaCw5ldJOXw2mYbHQ6fE0DymGSVGroru3UABsOksResqlaVwss4LdHuLw1ZLPIHlElujGwNRdb9hR-6-1empSzKinFUw"
      ],
      "description": "The cursor returned by your last call to list_folder or list_folder/continue. Use this to paginate through all files and retrieve updates to the folder."
    }
  }
}
```

## DROPBOX_LIST_FOLDER_MEMBERS
Tool to list members of a shared folder, including users, groups, and invitees. Use when you need to retrieve information about who has access to a specific shared folder and their permission levels.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListFolderMembersRequest",
  "required": [
    "shared_folder_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "default": 1000,
      "maximum": 1000,
      "minimum": 1,
      "description": "The maximum number of results that include members, groups and invitees to return per request"
    },
    "actions": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Actions",
      "description": "List indicating whether each returned member will include a boolean value showing if the current user can perform the MemberAction on the member. Valid values: 'leave_a_copy', 'make_editor', 'make_owner', 'make_viewer', 'make_viewer_no_comment', 'remove'"
    },
    "shared_folder_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Shared Folder Id",
      "examples": [
        "84528192421"
      ],
      "description": "The ID for the shared folder"
    }
  }
}
```

## DROPBOX_LIST_FOLDER_MEMBERS_CONTINUE
Tool to continue paginating through shared folder members using a cursor from list_folder_members. Use when cursor is present in list_folder_members response to retrieve remaining member entries.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListFolderMembersContinueRequest",
  "required": [
    "cursor"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "cursor": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Cursor",
      "examples": [
        "AhHdpP3yi-6qOSoY_epBXgEbKTbPQ3BidBe5QX2mfv90FCC_rR__814MZb3yBrSkHqwyVUo9mwjqGbkxCsDwnfqCTmsaA5vLEXYexqNx6puKy3ZGQtNFdPJsLeq9QITY9NFTBs4Dnke6-Lm74jmHPpQm0FUBT_tTW30cjP7yv-ONdw"
      ],
      "description": "The cursor returned by your last call to list_folder_members or list_folder_members/continue. Use this to paginate through all shared folder members."
    }
  }
}
```

## DROPBOX_LIST_FOLDERS
DEPRECATED: Use ListFilesInFolder instead. Retrieves a list of folders, files, and deleted entries from a specified Dropbox path.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListFoldersRequest",
  "properties": {
    "path": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Path",
      "default": "",
      "description": "Path to the folder (e.g., \"\" for root, \"/folder/subfolder\", or \"id:abc123xyz\"). If a path string, it must start with / and not end with / or whitespace."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "default": 2000,
      "maximum": 2000,
      "minimum": 1,
      "description": "Maximum number of folder entries to return per request; an approximate upper bound."
    },
    "recursive": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Recursive",
      "default": false,
      "description": "Whether to include folders in nested subfolders (True) or only immediate subfolders (False) Combining with a high `limit` or broad `path` can yield very large responses; scope `path` narrowly to keep result sets manageable."
    },
    "include_deleted": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Include Deleted",
      "default": false,
      "description": "Whether to include folders that have been deleted but may be recoverable"
    }
  }
}
```

## DROPBOX_LIST_FOLDERS_CONTINUE
Tool to continue paginating through shared folders using a cursor from list_folders. Use when the cursor is present in list_folders response to retrieve remaining shared folder entries.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListFoldersContinueRequest",
  "required": [
    "cursor"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "cursor": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Cursor",
      "examples": [
        "AhEZoCTVobpJ50FL9o65wOvibCEMRe8vuB4Qf-5GzuHNpvqavj4GzN3qfZBcHPiqRdSFAgjbLmA58TWgikdObP1Egk2HOLsEXtlAkWjOLbEyYI9XRqIBHM8Hdl-r-DGJeCDG01JFxQqGdfYDh_ZZx1RTRRHzVoQXMLH3oHJqpo7O0IvYlTKxSfesfY1SLuEllK-ngYDCRNvn0tytM2DM7tGP02s_FWcXV_N7Ak9IMCj1Hw"
      ],
      "description": "The cursor returned by the previous call to list_folders or list_folders/continue. Use this to paginate through all shared folders."
    }
  }
}
```

## DROPBOX_LIST_MEMBER_LINKED_APPS
Tool to list all applications linked to a specific team member's account. Use when you need to audit or review which third-party applications have been authorized by a particular team member.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListMemberLinkedAppsRequest",
  "required": [
    "team_member_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "team_member_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Team Member Id",
      "examples": [
        "dbmid:AACzIks68_T0zljJAk8hGSmt0rLx6g5X9p0"
      ],
      "description": "The team member ID. Can be obtained from team/members/list endpoint."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for listing a specific team member's linked applications."
}
```

## DROPBOX_LIST_MOUNTABLE_FOLDERS
Tool to list all shared folders the current user can mount or unmount. Use when discovering mountable shared folders (unmounted folders can be identified by absence of path_lower field). This endpoint does not support apps with the app folder permission.

**Input schema:**

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListMountableFoldersRequest",
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "minimum": 1,
      "description": "Maximum number of mountable folders to return per request. If not specified, the API will use its default limit."
    },
    "actions": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "FolderAction",
        "required": [
          ".tag"
        ],

          ".tag": {

            "title": ".Tag",

        }
      },
      "title": "Actions",
      "description": "List of FolderActions corresponding to FolderPermissions that should appear in the response's SharedFolderMetadata.permissions field, describing the actions the authenticated user can perform on the folder."
    }
  }
}
```

## DROPBOX_LIST_MOUNTABLE_FOLDERS_CONTINUE
Tool to paginate through mountable shared folders using a cursor. Use when you have a cursor from a previous call to list_mountable_folders or list_mountable_folders/continue and need to retrieve the next batch of folders.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListMountableFoldersContinueRequest",
  "required": [
    "cursor"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "cursor": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Cursor",
      "examples": [
        "AhFFlnMhPWwceCrpaXF0ifpPl0fjff8G3VN7SqR0RT-xlD1qPgBypIZPneBv5QYQ0bT_rYaz7avfSjdk_fVdmgPCMlx5j0QWoKik4rnCfDkc-dW3JmlJGQwMNB4Mh4ZPcGxm_9BYgREmcPOVmjUwvulqa3mY7XY97ixvun0oYRMuIMFFPTp3XWFxns_8FX-dXAbVmlHI5G5UlzitPS4K6UaoDiw9eubAEClOdryO25mh9Q"
      ],
      "description": "The cursor returned by a previous call to list_mountable_folders or list_mountable_folders/continue. Use this to paginate through all mountable shared folders."
    }
  }
}
```

## DROPBOX_LIST_PAPER_DOCS
Tool to return the list of all Paper docs according to filter and sort specifications. Use when you need to retrieve Paper document IDs for further operations. To iterate through full pagination, pass the cursor to docs/list/continue.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListPaperDocsRequest",
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "maximum": 1000,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        100,
        500,
        1000
      ],
      "description": "Size limit per batch. The maximum number of docs that can be retrieved per batch is 1000. Higher value results in invalid arguments error."
    },
    "sort_by": {
      "enum": [
        "accessed",
        "modified",
        "created"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Sort By",
      "examples": [
        "accessed",
        "modified",
        "created"
      ],
      "description": "Allows user to specify how the Paper docs should be sorted. 'accessed' sorts by last accessed time, 'modified' sorts by last modified time, 'created' sorts by creation time."
    },
    "filter_by": {
      "enum": [
        "docs_accessed",
        "docs_created"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Filter By",
      "examples": [
        "docs_accessed",
        "docs_created"
      ],
      "description": "Allows user to specify how the Paper docs should be filtered. 'docs_accessed' fetches all Paper doc IDs that the user has ever accessed. 'docs_created' fetches only the Paper doc IDs that the user has created."
    },
    "sort_order": {
      "enum": [
        "ascending",
        "descending"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Sort Order",
      "examples": [
        "ascending",
        "descending"
      ],
      "description": "Allows user to specify the sort order of the result. 'ascending' sorts in ascending order, 'descending' sorts in descending order."
    }
  }
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json

  "$defs": {

      "type": "object",
      "title": "Cursor",

        "value"

      "properties": {
        "value": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Value",
          "description": "The cursor value to pass to docs/list/continue for pagination."
        }
      }
    },
    "ListPaperDocsResponse": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "ListPaperDocsResponse",
      "required": [
        "doc_ids",

        "has_more"
      ],
      "properties": {

          "type": "object",

          "required": [
            "value"
          ],
          "properties": {
            "value": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Value",
              "description": "The cursor value to pass to docs/list/continue for pagination."
            }
          },
          "description": "Pass the cursor into docs/list/continue to paginate through all files."
        },
        "doc_ids": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "title": "Doc Ids",
          "description": "The list of Paper doc IDs that can be used to access the given Paper docs or supplied to other API methods."
        },
        "has_more": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Has More",
          "description": "Will be set to True if a subsequent call with the provided cursor to docs/list/continue returns immediately with some results."
```

## DROPBOX_LIST_PAPER_DOCS_CONTINUE
Tool to continue paginating through Paper documents using a cursor from paper/docs/list. Use when has_more is true to retrieve remaining Paper documents. Note: This endpoint continues to work for older Paper content; check user features to determine Paper version.

**Input schema:**
```json

  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListPaperDocsContinueRequest",
  "required": [
    "cursor"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "cursor": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Cursor",
      "examples": [
        ""
      ],
      "description": "The cursor obtained from paper/docs/list or paper/docs/list/continue. Allows for pagination through all Paper documents."
    }
  }
}
```

## DROPBOX_LIST_RECEIVED_FILES
Tool to list all files shared with the current user. Returns files directly shared with the user but does not include files received via shared folders or unclaimed invitations. Use when discovering files that have been shared with the authenticated user.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListReceivedFilesRequest",
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "default": 100,
      "maximum": 300,
      "minimum": 1,
      "description": "Number of files to return max per query. Defaults to 100 if no limit is specified. Must be between 1 and 300."
    },
    "actions": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "FileAction",
        "required": [
          ".tag"
        ],
        "properties": {
          ".tag": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": ".Tag",
            "description": "The file action type. Possible values: 'disable_viewer_info', 'edit_contents', 'enable_viewer_info', 'invite_viewer', 'invite_viewer_no_comment', 'unshare', 'relinquish_membership', 'share_link', 'create_link', 'other'"
          }
        },
        "description": "Actions that may be taken on files."
      },
      "title": "Actions",
      "description": "A list of FileActions corresponding to FilePermissions that should appear in the response's SharedFileMetadata.permissions field describing the actions the authenticated user can perform on the file."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for listing received files."
}
```

## DROPBOX_LIST_SHARED_FOLDERS
Tool to list all shared folders the authenticated user has access to. Use when discovering shared or team-mounted folders that may not appear in a standard path listing. Returns metadata including folder name, ID, access level, and paths (if mounted).

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListSharedFoldersRequest",
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "default": 1000,
      "maximum": 1000,
      "minimum": 1,
      "description": "Maximum number of shared folders to return per request"
    }
  }
}
```

## DROPBOX_LIST_SHARED_LINKS
Tool to list existing shared links for the current user, optionally filtered by path. Use when you need to discover or reuse existing shared links to avoid creating duplicates or to check what links already exist for a file or folder. Supports pagination via cursor for large result sets.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListSharedLinksRequest",
  "properties": {
    "path": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Path",
      "examples": [
        "/Documents/report.pdf",
        "/Photos/vacation.jpg",
        ""
      ],
      "description": "The path to the file or folder to list shared links for. If omitted, returns all shared links for the current user. If provided, returns links that grant access to the specified path (including parent folder links unless direct_only is true). Supports Dropbox path notation (e.g., '/folder/file.txt')."
    },
    "cursor": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Cursor",
      "description": "The cursor returned by a previous call to this endpoint. Use this to retrieve additional results when 'has_more' is true. The API returns a maximum of ~200 links per call."
    },
    "direct_only": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Direct Only",
      "description": "If true, only return direct links to the specified path. If false or omitted, also include links to parent folders. Only relevant when 'path' is specified."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for listing shared links."
}
```

## DROPBOX_LIST_TEAM_DEVICES
Tool to list all device sessions of a team including web sessions, desktop clients, and mobile clients. Use when you need to audit team devices, view active sessions, or monitor device activity across the team. Supports pagination via cursor for large result sets. Requires team admin credentials.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListTeamDevicesRequest",
  "properties": {
    "cursor": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Cursor",
      "description": "Pagination cursor for retrieving additional results. At the first call to list_team_devices, the cursor shouldn't be passed. Then, if the result includes a cursor, subsequent requests should include the received cursor to retrieve the next sub-list of team devices."
    },
    "include_web_sessions": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Include Web Sessions",
      "description": "Whether to list web sessions of the team members. If omitted, defaults to the API's default behavior."
    },
    "include_mobile_clients": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Include Mobile Clients",
      "description": "Whether to list mobile clients of the team members. If omitted, defaults to the API's default behavior."
    },
    "include_desktop_clients": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Include Desktop Clients",
      "description": "Whether to list desktop clients of the team members. If omitted, defaults to the API's default behavior."
    }
  }
}
```

## DROPBOX_LIST_TEAM_GROUP_MEMBERS
Tool to list members of a Dropbox team group. Use when you need to retrieve the list of team members who belong to a specific group. Returns member profiles with email, status, and access information.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListTeamGroupMembersRequest",
  "required": [
    "selector_type"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "default": 1000,
      "maximum": 1000,
      "minimum": 1,
      "description": "Maximum number of members to return per request. Must be between 1 and 1000."
    },
    "group_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Group Id",
      "examples": [
        "g:e18cdeb8c1e9c0280000000000000003"
      ],
      "description": "The Dropbox group ID. Required when selector_type is 'group_id'. Example: 'g:e18cdeb8c1e9c0280000000000000003'"
    },
    "selector_type": {
      "enum": [
        "group_id",
        "group_external_id"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Selector Type",
      "examples": [
        "group_id",
        "group_external_id"
      ],
      "description": "The type of selector to use for identifying the group. 'group_id' - Select group by Dropbox group ID. 'group_external_id' - Select group by external ID."
    },
    "group_external_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Group External Id",
      "description": "The external ID of the group. Required when selector_type is 'group_external_id'. This is the ID from an external system that has been associated with the Dropbox group."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for listing members of a team group."
}
```

## DROPBOX_LIST_TEAM_GROUPS
Tool to list all groups on a Dropbox team. Use when you need to see all team groups with their metadata including group ID, name, and member count.

**Input schema:**
```json

  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "minimum": 1,
      "description": "Number of groups to return per call. If not specified, all groups are returned."
    }
  }
}
```

## DROPBOX_LIST_TEAM_LINKED_APPS
Tool to list all applications linked to team members' accounts. Use when you need to audit or review which third-party applications have been authorized by team members. Supports pagination for large teams.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListTeamLinkedAppsRequest",
  "properties": {
    "cursor": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Cursor",
      "examples": [
        "ZtkX9_EHj3x7PMkVuFIhwKYXEpwpLwyxp9vMKomUhllil9q7eWiAu"
      ],
      "description": "At the first call, the cursor shouldn't be passed. Then, if the result includes a cursor, subsequent requests should include the received cursor to receive the next sub-list of team applications."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for listing team members' linked applications."
}
```

## DROPBOX_LIST_TEAM_MEMBER_DEVICES
Tool to list all device sessions of a team's member, including web sessions, desktop clients, and mobile clients. Use when you need to retrieve information about a team member's active devices and sessions.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListTeamMemberDevicesRequest",
  "required": [
    "team_member_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "team_member_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Team Member Id",
      "examples": [
        "dbmid:AACzIks68_T0zljJAk8hGSmt0rLx6g5X9p0"
      ],
      "description": "The team's member id. Can be obtained from team/members/list endpoint."
    },
    "include_web_sessions": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Include Web Sessions",
      "default": true,
      "description": "Whether to list web sessions of the team's member. Defaults to true."
    },
    "include_mobile_clients": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Include Mobile Clients",
      "default": true,
      "description": "Whether to list linked mobile devices of the team's member. Defaults to true."
    },
    "include_desktop_clients": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Include Desktop Clients",
      "default": true,
      "description": "Whether to list linked desktop devices of the team's member. Defaults to true."
    }
  }
}
```

## DROPBOX_LIST_TEAM_MEMBERS
Tool to list members of a Dropbox team. Use when you need to retrieve information about team members, including their status, roles, and contact details. Supports pagination for teams with many members.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListTeamMembersRequest",
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "maximum": 1000,
      "minimum": 1,
      "description": "Number of results to return per call. Maximum is 1000. If not specified, the server will use a default value."
    },
```

## DROPBOX_LIST_TEAM_MEMBERS_CONTINUE
Tool to continue listing team members using a cursor from team/members/list or team/members/list/continue_v2. Use when you have a cursor from a previous team members list call and need to retrieve the next batch of members.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListTeamMembersContinueRequest",
  "required": [
    "cursor"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "cursor": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Cursor",
      "examples": [
        "AAQwkgr3PAthE6u1nueULylh7zNad5wE6YKisbxiFWkk4kcjMqtHTZEnX2jIhV7uUU6_MUpyGcnXe2qIPjED1euB1CmLL3ba_LHK-xTYZizaaA"
      ],
      "description": "The cursor returned by team/members/list or team/members/list/continue_v2. Indicates from what point to get the next set of members."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for continuing to list team members."
}
```

## DROPBOX_MODIFY_SHARED_LINK_SETTINGS
Tool to modify settings of an existing Dropbox shared link. Use when the user needs to change visibility, access permissions, expiration, or password settings for a shared link. Supports changing audience (public/team/private), access level (viewer/editor), expiration dates, and password protection.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ModifySharedLinkSettingsRequest",
  "required": [
    "url",
    "settings"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "url": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Url",
      "examples": [
        "https://www.dropbox.com/s/2sn712vy1ovegw8/Prime_Numbers.txt?dl=0",
        "https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fi/fduuvsq7nid5c9mmblynm/test_file.txt?rlkey=qqw53aps5dswr4x80xkily4vf&dl=0"
      ],
      "description": "The URL of the shared link to modify. This must be a valid Dropbox shared link URL."
    },
    "settings": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Settings",
      "properties": {
        "access": {
          "enum": [
            "viewer",
            "editor"
          ],
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Access",
          "description": "The requested access level for the link. 'viewer' - Users can view and comment on content. 'editor' - Users can edit content."
        },
        "expires": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Expires",
          "examples": [
            "2026-12-31T23:59:59Z",
            "2027-01-15T12:00:00Z"
          ],
          "description": "The expiration date and time for the link in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2026-12-31T23:59:59Z'). If not set, the link will not expire."
        },
        "audience": {
          "enum": [
            "public",
            "team",
            "no_one"
          ],
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Audience",
          "description": "Who can benefit from the access level of the link. 'public' - Link is accessible by anyone. 'team' - Link is accessible by team members only. 'no_one' - The link doesn't grant access."
        },
        "link_password": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Link Password",
          "description": "The password for the link if 'require_password' is true. Only applicable when password protection is enabled for the account."
        },
        "allow_download": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Allow Download",
          "description": "Whether to allow download of the shared file or folder. If not set, defaults to true."
        },
        "require_password": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Require Password",
          "description": "Whether to require a password to access the link. If true, you must also provide 'link_password'."
        },
        "requested_visibility": {
          "enum": [
            "public",
            "team_only",
            "no_one"
          ],
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Requested Visibility",
          "description": "The requested visibility for the link. 'public' - Anyone with the link can access. 'team_only' - Only team members can access. 'no_one' - Link does not grant access. Note: This field is deprecated; use 'audience' instead for newer implementations."
        }
      },
      "description": "The new settings to apply to the shared link. Only the specified fields will be updated; unspecified fields remain unchanged.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "remove_expiration": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Remove Expiration",
      "default": false,
      "description": "If set to true, removes the expiration date from the shared link. This overrides any 'expires' value in settings."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for modifying shared link settings."
}
```

## DROPBOX_MOUNT_FOLDER
Tool to mount a shared folder for the current user after they have been added as a member. Once mounted, the shared folder will appear in their Dropbox. Use when a user needs to access a shared folder that has been shared with them but not yet mounted.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "MountFolderRequest",
  "required": [
    "shared_folder_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "shared_folder_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Shared Folder Id",
      "examples": [
        "13512984419",
        "84528192341"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the shared folder to mount."
    }
  }
}
```

```json
        },

          "type": "object",
          "title": "Access Error",
          "required": [
            ".tag"
          ],
          "properties": {
            ".tag": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": ".Tag",
              "description": "Access error type: 'invalid_id', 'not_a_member', 'email_unverified', 'unmounted', or 'other'"
            }

            }
          },

        }
      },

    },
    "error": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Error",
      "description": "Error if any occurred during the execution of the action"
    },
    "successful": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Successful",
      "description": "Whether or not the action execution was successful or not"
    }
  }
}
```

## DROPBOX_MOVE_BATCH
Tool to move multiple files or folders to different locations at once in Dropbox. Use when you need to relocate several items in a single operation. Note that case-only renaming is not supported. The operation may complete synchronously (returning status for each entry) or asynchronously (returning a job ID to check later with move_batch/check:2).

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "DropboxMoveBatchRequest",
  "required": [
    "entries"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "entries": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "RelocationPath",
        "required": [
          "from_path",
          "to_path"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "to_path": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "To Path",
            "examples": [
              "/Homework/archive/math_prime_numbers.txt",
              "/Photos/2024/Vacation_moved"
            ],
            "description": "Path in the user's Dropbox that is the destination. This path is case-sensitive."
          },
          "from_path": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "From Path",
            "examples": [
              "/Homework/math/prime_numbers.txt",
              "/Photos/Vacation"
            ],
            "description": "Path in the user's Dropbox to be moved. This path is case-sensitive."
          }
        },
        "description": "A single entry in a batch move operation, specifying source and destination paths."
      },
      "title": "Entries",
      "examples": [
        [
          {
            "to_path": "/Archive/prime_numbers.txt",
            "from_path": "/Homework/math/prime_numbers.txt"
          }
        ]
      ],
      "maxItems": 1000,
      "minItems": 1,
      "description": "List of entries to be moved. Each entry specifies a from_path and to_path. Minimum 1 entry, maximum 1000 entries."
    },
    "autorename": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Autorename",
      "default": false,
      "description": "If there's a conflict with any file, have the Dropbox server try to autorename that file to avoid the conflict. The default is false."
    },
    "allow_ownership_transfer": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Allow Ownership Transfer",
      "default": false,
      "description": "Allow moves by owner even if it would result in an ownership transfer for the content being moved. The default is false."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for moving multiple files or folders in a batch operation."
}
```

## DROPBOX_MOVE_FILE_OR_FOLDER
Move file or folder

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "DropboxMoveFileOrFolderRequest",
  "required": [
    "from_path",
    "to_path"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "to_path": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "To Path",
      "examples": [
        "/Homework/archive/math_prime_numbers.txt",
        "/Photos/2024/Vacation_renamed"
      ],
      "description": "Path in the user's Dropbox that is the destination. This path is case-sensitive."
    },
    "from_path": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "From Path",
      "examples": [
        "/Homework/math/prime_numbers.txt",
        "/Photos/Vacation"
      ],
      "description": "Path in the user's Dropbox to be moved. This path is case-sensitive. Use canonical paths from metadata (path_display or path_lower) rather than manually constructed strings to avoid path/not_found errors."
    },
    "autorename": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Autorename",
      "default": false,
      "description": "If there's a conflict (e.g., a file with the same name already exists at the destination), have the Dropbox server try to auto-rename the file to avoid the conflict. The default is false. Leaving this false will cause the call to fail outright when a name conflict exists at the destination."
    },
    "allow_shared_folder": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Allow Shared Folder",
      "default": false,
      "description": "If true, allows moving shared folders. The default is false."
    },
    "allow_ownership_transfer": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Allow Ownership Transfer",
      "default": false,
      "description": "Allow moves by owner even if it would result in an ownership transfer for the content being moved. This does not apply to copies. The default is false."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for moving a file or folder in Dropbox."
}
```

## DROPBOX_OVERWRITE_FILE_PROPERTIES
Tool to overwrite property groups associated with a file or folder. Use when you need to force apply or replace custom property values for specific templates on a file.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "OverwriteFilePropertiesRequest",
  "required": [
    "path",
    "property_groups"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "path": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Path",
      "examples": [
        "/test_file.txt",
        "/Documents/report.pdf",
        "id:a4ayc_80_OEAAAAAAAAAXz"
      ],
      "description": "A unique identifier for the file or folder. Can be a path (e.g., '/test_file.txt') or a file ID."
    },
    "property_groups": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "PropertyGroup",
        "required": [
          "template_id",
          "fields"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "fields": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "type": "object",
              "title": "PropertyGroupField",
              "required": [
                "name",
                "value"
              ],
              "properties": {
                "name": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "title": "Name",
                  "examples": [
                    "status",
                    "priority",
                    "category"
                  ],
                  "description": "The name or key of the custom property field."
                },
                "value": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "title": "Value",
                  "examples": [
                    "active",
                    "high",
                    "urgent"
                  ],
                  "description": "The value of the custom property field."
                }
              },
              "description": "A single custom property field with name and value."
            },
            "title": "Fields",
            "description": "The list of property field values for this property group. There can be up to 32 property types per template."
          },
          "template_id": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Template Id",
            "examples": [
              "ptid:4YzeuMHpwCgAAAAAAAAAQA"
            ],
            "description": "A unique identifier for the property template in the format 'ptid:...'."
          }
        },
        "description": "A group of custom properties to apply to a file or folder."
      },
      "title": "Property Groups",
      "description": "The property groups to force apply. This operation will overwrite existing property groups for the specified templates."
    },
    "Dropbox-API-Select-User": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Dropbox Api Select User",
      "examples": [
        "dbmid:AACzIks68_T0zljJAk8hGSmt0rLx6g5X9p0"
      ],
      "description": "Team member ID (format: dbmid:...) required when using team tokens. Specifies which team member's account to operate on."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request to overwrite property groups associated with a file or folder."
}
```

## DROPBOX_READ_FILE
Downloads a file from the specified Dropbox path, requiring `files.content.read` scope. Response field `file_content_bytes` is base64-encoded binary; decode before saving or passing to libraries. Bursty reads may trigger HTTP 429; honor the `Retry-After` header.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ReadFileOrFolderRequest",
  "required": [
    "path"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "path": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Path",
      "examples": [
        "/photo.jpg",
        "/Documents/file.pdf",
        "/Homework/math/Matrices.txt"
      ],
      "description": "The path to search in Must be a canonical Dropbox path from `path_display` or `path_lower` in API results \u2014 hand-typed paths frequently cause not-found or 409 errors. Paths in shared/team folders may become invalid if items are moved or access is revoked."
    }
  }
}
```

## DROPBOX_REMOVE_FILE_MEMBER
Tool to remove a specified member from a file's sharing permissions. Use when you need to revoke a member's access to a shared file. Note: This does not support apps with the app folder permission.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "RemoveFileMemberRequest",
  "required": [
    "file",
    "member"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "file": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "File",
      "examples": [
        "id:7bh4zBmgZoAAAAAAAAAAFg",
        "/Documents/shared_file.pdf"
      ],
      "description": "File from which to remove members. Use the file ID in the format 'id:...' or the file path."
    },
    "member": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Member",
      "required": [
        ".tag"
      ],
      "properties": {
        ".tag": {
          "enum": [
            "dropbox_id",
            "email"
          ],
          "type": "string",
          "title": ".Tag",
          "examples": [
            "email",
            "dropbox_id"
          ],
          "description": "How to identify the member. 'dropbox_id' - Use Dropbox account, team member, or group ID. 'email' - Use email address of the member."
        },
        "email": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Email",
          "examples": [
            "test.member@example.com",
            "user@company.com"
          ],
          "description": "Email address of member. Required when tag is 'email'. Note: Even if an email is specified, it may result in removal of a user (not an invitee) if the user's main account corresponds to that email."
        },
        "dropbox_id": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Dropbox Id",
          "examples": [
            "dbid:AAH4f99T0taONIb-OurWxbNQ6ywGRopQngc"
          ],
          "description": "Dropbox account, team member, or group ID of member. Required when tag is 'dropbox_id'."
        }
      },
      "description": "Member to remove from this file. Specify either by email or dropbox_id.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for removing a member from a file."
}
```

```json
                  "parent_shared_folder_id": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "title": "Parent Shared Folder Id",
                    "description": "The ID of the parent shared folder."
                  }
                },
                "description": "Access details for a parent folder."
              },
              "title": "Access Details",
              "description": "The parent folders that a member has access to. Present if the user has access to the first parent folder where the member gains access."
            }
          },
          "description": "This member does not have explicit access to the file and therefore cannot be removed. The member may have access through a parent folder."
```
```json
        }
      },
      "description": "Data from the action execution"
    },
    "error": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Error",
      "description": "Error if any occurred during the execution of the action"
    },
    "successful": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Successful",
      "description": "Whether or not the action execution was successful or not"
    }
  }
}
```

## DROPBOX_REMOVE_FOLDER_MEMBER
Tool to remove a member from a shared folder. Use when an owner or editor needs to revoke access for a user or group. The member can be identified by email or Dropbox ID. On success, the response is empty; on error, contains detailed error information.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "RemoveFolderMemberRequest",
  "required": [
    "shared_folder_id",
    "member"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "member": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Member",
      "required": [
        ".tag"
      ],
      "properties": {
        ".tag": {
          "enum": [
            "dropbox_id",
            "email"
          ],
          "type": "string",
          "title": ".Tag",
          "examples": [
            "email",
            "dropbox_id"
          ],
          "description": "Type of member identifier: 'dropbox_id' for Dropbox account/team/group ID, or 'email' for email address"
        },
        "email": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Email",
          "examples": [
            "test.member@example.com"
          ],
          "description": "E-mail address of the member. Required when tag is 'email'"
        },
        "dropbox_id": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Dropbox Id",
          "examples": [
            "dbid:AAH4f99T0taONIb-OurWxbNQ6ywGRopQngc"
          ],
          "description": "Dropbox account, team member, or group ID of the member. Required when tag is 'dropbox_id'"
        }
      },
      "description": "The member to remove from the shared folder. Can be identified by email address or Dropbox ID",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "leave_a_copy": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Leave A Copy",
      "default": false,
      "description": "If true, the removed user will keep their copy of the folder after it's unshared (if mounted). Otherwise, it will be removed from their Dropbox. Must be false when kicking a group"
    },
    "shared_folder_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Shared Folder Id",
      "examples": [
        "13497809747",
        "84528192421"
      ],
      "description": "The ID for the shared folder from which to remove the member"
    }
  }
}
```

## DROPBOX_REMOVE_GROUP_MEMBERS
Tool to remove members from a Dropbox team group. Use when you need to remove one or more users from a team group. Requires team admin permissions.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "RemoveGroupMembersRequest",
  "required": [
    "group",
    "users"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "group": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Group",
      "required": [
        ".tag"
      ],
      "properties": {
        ".tag": {
          "enum": [
            "group_id",
            "group_external_id"
          ],
          "type": "string",
          "title": ".Tag",
          "description": "Type of group identifier: 'group_id' for Dropbox group ID, 'group_external_id' for external group ID"
        },
        "group_id": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Group Id",
          "examples": [
            "g:e18cdeb8c1e9c0280000000000000055"
          ],
          "description": "The unique Dropbox group ID. Required when tag is 'group_id'"
        },
        "group_external_id": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Group External Id",
          "description": "The external group ID. Required when tag is 'group_external_id'"
        }
      },
      "description": "The group from which users will be removed. Specify either by group_id or group_external_id",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "users": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "UserSelector",
        "required": [
          ".tag"
        ],
        "properties": {
          ".tag": {
            "enum": [
              "team_member_id",
              "external_id",
              "email"
            ],
            "type": "string",
            "title": ".Tag",
            "description": "Type of user identifier: 'team_member_id' for Dropbox team member ID, 'external_id' for external user ID, 'email' for email address"
          },
          "email": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Email",
            "examples": [
              "user@example.com"
            ],
            "description": "The user's email address. Required when tag is 'email'"
          },
          "external_id": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "External Id",
            "description": "The external user ID. Required when tag is 'external_id'"
          },
          "team_member_id": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Team Member Id",
            "examples": [
              "dbmid:AACwJ2ojytbXGFyiUs6_0Py3GqOt2LyicSg"
            ],
            "description": "The Dropbox team member ID. Required when tag is 'team_member_id'"
          }
        },
        "description": "Selector for specifying a user by team member ID, external ID, or email."
      },
      "title": "Users",
      "minItems": 1,
      "description": "List of users to be removed from the group. Each user can be identified by team_member_id, external_id, or email"
    },
    "return_members": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Return Members",
      "default": false,
      "description": "Whether to return the list of members in the group after removal. Note that setting this to true may take a long time for large groups. Default is false"
    }
  }
}
```

## DROPBOX_REMOVE_SHARING_ALLOWLIST
Tool to remove domains or email addresses from the team sharing allowlist. Use when team admins need to revoke approval for specific domains or emails. Requires team admin authentication. At least one of 'domains' or 'emails' must be provided, with a maximum of 1000 entries per call. Entries must already exist on the allowlist.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "RemoveSharingAllowlistRequest",
  "properties": {
    "emails": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Emails",
      "examples": [
        "user@example.com",
        "partner@company.org",
        "admin@client.net"
      ],
      "maxItems": 1000,
      "description": "List of email addresses to remove from the allowlist. Each email must be a valid string representation following RFC-5322/822 (e.g., 'user@example.com'). Entries must already exist on the allowlist. Maximum 1000 entries per call. At least one of 'domains' or 'emails' must be provided"
    },
    "domains": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Domains",
      "examples": [
        "example.com",
        "partner.org",
        "client-company.net"
      ],
      "maxItems": 1000,
      "description": "List of domains to remove from the allowlist. Each domain must be a valid string representation following RFC-1034/5 (e.g., 'example.com', 'subdomain.example.org'). Entries must already exist on the allowlist. Maximum 1000 entries per call. At least one of 'domains' or 'emails' must be provided"
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for removing entries from the team sharing allowlist."
}
```

## DROPBOX_RESEND_SECONDARY_EMAIL_VERIFICATION
Tool to resend secondary email verification emails to team members. Use when team members need verification emails resent for their secondary email addresses. Requires team admin credentials.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ResendSecondaryEmailVerificationRequest",
  "required": [
    "emails_to_resend"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "emails_to_resend": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "EmailsToResendItem",
        "required": [
          "user",
          "secondary_emails"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "user": {
            "type": "object",
            "title": "User",
            "required": [
              ".tag"
            ],
            "properties": {
              ".tag": {
                "enum": [
                  "team_member_id",
                  "email"
                ],
                "type": "string",
                "title": ".Tag",
                "description": "Type of user identifier: 'team_member_id' for team member ID, 'email' for email address"
              },
              "email": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Email",
                "examples": [
                  "test@example.com",
                  "user@company.com"
                ],
                "description": "Email address of the user. Required when tag is 'email'"
              },
              "team_member_id": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Team Member Id",
                "examples": [
                  "dbmid:test123",
                  "dbmid:FDFSVF-DFSDF"
                ],
                "description": "Team member ID of the user. Required when tag is 'team_member_id'"
              }
            },
            "description": "The team member to resend verification emails for",
            "additionalProperties": false
          },
          "secondary_emails": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "type": "string"
            },
            "title": "Secondary Emails",
            "examples": [
              [
                "secondary@example.com"
              ],
              [
                "backup@example.com",
                "alternate@example.com"
              ]
            ],
            "minItems": 1,
            "description": "List of secondary email addresses to resend verification emails to"
          }
        },
        "description": "Specifies a user and their secondary emails to resend verification for."
      },
      "title": "Emails To Resend",
      "minItems": 1,
      "description": "Collection of users paired with secondary emails needing verification resent. Each item contains the user identifier and list of secondary email addresses"
    }
  }
}
```

## DROPBOX_RESTORE_FILE
Tool to restore a specific revision of a file to the given path in Dropbox. Use when you need to revert a file to a previous version using its revision identifier.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "RestoreFileRequest",
  "required": [
    "path",
    "rev"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "rev": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Rev",
      "examples": [
        "01649efbe6f88ab00000002e00499b3",
        "015a01044acb99900000001aa8954d0"
      ],
      "description": "The revision to restore for the file. This is a unique identifier for a specific version of the file."
    },
    "path": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Path",
      "examples": [
        "/test_restore_file.txt",
        "/Documents/report.pdf"
      ],
      "description": "The path to the file you want to restore in the user's Dropbox. Path is case-sensitive."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for restoring a file to a specific revision."
}
```

## DROPBOX_REVOKE_SHARED_LINK
Tool to revoke a Dropbox shared link. Use when you need to remove access to a file or folder by disabling its shared link. Note that revoking a direct link to a file may not fully prevent access if parent folders have active shared links.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "RevokeSharedLinkRequest",
  "required": [
    "url"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "url": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Url",
      "examples": [
```

## DROPBOX_SAVE_COPY_REFERENCE
Tool to save a copy reference to the user's Dropbox. Use when you have a copy reference (obtained from copy_reference/get) and need to save it to a specific destination path.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "DropboxCopyReferenceSaveRequest",
  "required": [
    "copy_reference",
    "path"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "path": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Path",
      "examples": [
        "/test_file_copy_saved.txt",
        "/Documents/copied_file.pdf"
      ],
      "description": "Path in the user's Dropbox that is the destination where the referenced file or folder will be saved. This path is case-sensitive and must start with '/'."
    },
    "copy_reference": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Copy Reference",
      "examples": [
        "AAAAAuAEmbNibzBibzd2dnR5dG0"
      ],
      "description": "A copy reference returned by copy_reference/get. This is an opaque string that can be used to save a file or folder to the user's Dropbox."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for saving a copy reference to Dropbox."
}
```

## DROPBOX_SAVE_URL
Tool to save a file to Dropbox directly from a public URL via server-side fetch. Use when you have a temporary or public link and want Dropbox to download it directly without local staging. The operation is asynchronous and may take up to 15 minutes for large files.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "SaveUrlRequest",
  "required": [
    "path",
    "url"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "url": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Url",
      "examples": [
        "https://example.com/file.pdf",
        "https://example.com/image.jpg"
      ],
      "description": "The URL to be saved. Must be a valid, publicly accessible URL."
    },
    "path": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Path",
      "examples": [
        "/images/downloaded.png",
        "/documents/report.pdf"
      ],
      "description": "The path in Dropbox where the URL will be saved to (including filename). Must start with a slash."
    },
    "wait": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Wait",
      "default": true,
      "description": "If true, poll the job status until completion or timeout. If false, return the async_job_id immediately."
    },
    "timeout_seconds": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Timeout Seconds",
      "default": 120,
      "minimum": 1,
      "description": "Maximum time in seconds to wait for job completion when wait=true. Ignored if wait=false."
    },
    "Dropbox-API-Select-User": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Dropbox Api Select User",
      "examples": [
        "dbmid:AACzIks68_T0zljJAk8hGSmt0rLx6g5X9p0"
      ],
      "description": "Team member ID (format: dbmid:...) required when using team tokens. Specifies which team member's account to operate on."
    }
  }
}
```

## DROPBOX_SEARCH_CONTINUE
Tool to fetch the next page of search results from a previous Dropbox search. Use when you have a cursor from a search operation and need to retrieve additional results. Note: search along with search_continue can only retrieve a maximum of 10,000 matches total.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "SearchContinueRequest",
  "required": [
    "cursor"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "cursor": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Cursor",
      "examples": [
        "ZtkX9_EHj3x7PMkVuFIhwKYXEpwpLwyxp9vMKomUhllil9q7eWiAu"
      ],
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "The cursor returned by your last call to search or search_continue. Used to fetch the next page of results."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for continuing a Dropbox search."
}
```

## DROPBOX_SEARCH_FILE_OR_FOLDER
Tool to search for files and folders in Dropbox by name or content, optionally scoped to a path, with pagination support. Results paginate via cursor (up to 100 per page); check `has_more` in the response and re-fetch with the cursor until `has_more` is false. Newly indexed items may have a brief delay before appearing. Verify `path_display` and `.tag` (file vs folder) on each result before acting, as multiple similar-named items may match. Results are limited to items visible to the authenticated user.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "SearchFileOrFolderRequest",
  "required": [
    "query"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "query": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Query",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "The search string. Must be 1 or more non-whitespace characters. Queries are case-insensitive."
    },
    "options": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "SearchOptions",
      "properties": {
        "path": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Path",
          "description": "Scopes the search to the given path and its subfolders. Provide an empty string to search the root. Non-root paths must start with '/' (e.g., '/my-folder'). If the leading slash is missing, it will be automatically prepended. If None, searches the entire Dropbox."
        },
        "order_by": {
          "enum": [
            "relevance",
            "last_modified_time"
          ],
          "type": "string",
          "title": "SearchOrderBy",
          "description": "Order by options for search results."
        },
        "file_status": {
          "enum": [
            "active",
            "deleted"
          ],
          "type": "string",
          "title": "File Status",
          "default": "active",
          "description": "Restricts search to files with the given status. Can be 'active' (default) or 'deleted'. To search both, omit this parameter or make separate requests."
        },
        "max_results": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "Max Results",
          "default": 100,
          "maximum": 1000,
          "minimum": 1,
          "description": "The maximum number of search results to return per request. Default is 100, min 1, max 1000."
        },
        "filename_only": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Filename Only",
          "default": false,
          "description": "Restricts search to only match on filenames."
        },
        "file_categories": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "enum": [
              "image",
              "document",
              "pdf",
              "spreadsheet",
              "presentation",
              "audio",
              "video",
              "folder",
              "paper",
              "others"
            ],
            "type": "string"
          },
          "title": "File Categories",
          "description": "Restricts search to only match files in the given categories."
        },
        "file_extensions": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "title": "File Extensions",
          "description": "Restricts search to only match files with the given extensions (e.g., ['jpg', 'png']). This is case-insensitive."
        }
      },
      "description": "Additional options for the search. If not provided, default search options will be used. Key sub-fields: `path` (must start with '/' or use 'id:...' format; omit to search entire account, narrow to reduce noise); `file_categories` and `file_extensions` to filter by type; no native date-range filter \u2014 apply date logic client-side using `server_modified` (UTC). Prefer reusing `path_display` values from prior results rather than manually composing paths.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "match_field_options": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "MatchFieldOptions",
      "properties": {
        "include_highlights": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Include Highlights",
          "default": false,
          "description": "If true, highlight information for the matches will be returned."
        }
      },
      "description": "Options for match field highlighting. If not provided, default options will be used.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "Dropbox-API-Select-User": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Dropbox Api Select User",
      "examples": [
        "dbmid:AACzIks68_T0zljJAk8hGSmt0rLx6g5X9p0"
      ],
      "description": "Team member ID (format: dbmid:...) required when using team tokens. Specifies which team member's account to operate on."
    }
  }
}
```

## DROPBOX_SEARCH_FILE_PROPERTIES
Tool to search across property templates for particular property field values. Use when you need to find files or folders that have specific custom property values (e.g., find all files with priority='high'). Note: This endpoint does not support apps with the app folder permission.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "SearchFilePropertiesRequest",
  "required": [
    "queries"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "queries": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "PropertiesSearchQuery",
        "required": [
          "query",
          "mode"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "mode": {
            "type": "object",
            "title": "Mode",
            "required": [
              "field_name"
            ],
            "properties": {
              ".tag": {
                "type": "string",
                "const": "field_name",
                "title": ".Tag",
                "default": "field_name",
                "description": "The type of search mode. Use 'field_name' to search for a value associated with a field name."
              },
              "field_name": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Field Name",
                "examples": [
                  "priority",
                  "status",
                  "category"
                ],
                "description": "The name of the property field to search within."
              }
            },
            "description": "The mode with which to perform the search, specifying which field to search within.",
            "additionalProperties": false
          },
          "query": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Query",
            "examples": [
              "high",
              "completed",
              "urgent"
            ],
            "description": "The property field value for which to search across templates."
          },
          "logical_operator": {
            "type": "object",
            "title": "LogicalOperator",
            "properties": {
              ".tag": {
                "type": "string",
                "const": "or_operator",
                "title": ".Tag",
                "default": "or_operator",
                "description": "The logical operator to join search queries. Currently only 'or_operator' is supported."
              }
            },
            "description": "The logical operator with which to append the query.",
            "additionalProperties": false
          }
        },
        "description": "A single search query for property field values."
      },
      "title": "Queries",
      "minItems": 1,
      "description": "List of queries to search. Each query specifies a property field value to search for and the field name to search within."
    },
    "template_filter": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "TemplateFilter",
      "required": [
        ".tag"
      ],
      "properties": {
        ".tag": {
          "enum": [
            "filter_some",
            "filter_none"
          ],
          "type": "string",
          "title": ".Tag",
          "examples": [
            "filter_none",
            "filter_some"
          ],
          "description": "The type of filter. Use 'filter_some' to filter by specific template IDs, or 'filter_none' to return all templates."
        },
        "filter_some": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "title": "Filter Some",
          "examples": [
            [
              "ptid:1a5n2i6d3OYEAAAAAAAAAYa",
              "ptid:2b6o3j7e4PZFBBBBBBBBBZb"
            ]
          ],
          "description": "List of template IDs to filter by. Only required when tag is 'filter_some'."
        }
      },
      "description": "Filter results to contain only properties associated with specific template IDs.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    }
  },
  "description": "Request to search across property templates for particular property field values."
}
```

## DROPBOX_SEND_TEAM_MEMBER_WELCOME_EMAIL
Tool to send a welcome email to a pending team member. Use when a team admin needs to resend or send a welcome email to a user who has been invited to the team.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "SendTeamMemberWelcomeEmailRequest",
  "required": [
    ".tag"
  ],
  "properties": {
    ".tag": {
      "enum": [
        "team_member_id",
        "external_id",
        "email"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": ".Tag",
      "description": "Type of identifier to use: 'team_member_id' for team member ID, 'external_id' for external ID, or 'email' for email address"
    },
    "email": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Email",
      "examples": [
        "partnerships@usefulagents.com",
        "user@example.com"
      ],
      "description": "Email address of the user. Required when tag is 'email'"
    },
    "external_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "External Id",
      "description": "External ID of the user. Required when tag is 'external_id'"
    },
    "team_member_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Team Member Id",
      "examples": [
        "dbmid:AAFdgehTzw7WlXhZJsbGCLePe8RvQGYDr-I"
      ],
      "description": "The team member ID of the user. Required when tag is 'team_member_id'"
    }
  }
}
```

## DROPBOX_SET_TEAM_MEMBER_CUSTOM_QUOTA
Tool to set custom storage quotas for team members in Dropbox. Use when you need to assign specific storage limits to individual team members. Maximum of 1000 users per request.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "SetTeamMemberCustomQuotaRequest",
  "required": [
    "users_and_quotas"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "users_and_quotas": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "UserAndQuota",
        "required": [
          "user",
          "quota_gb"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "user": {
            "type": "object",
            "title": "User",
            "properties": {
              "email": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Email",
                "examples": [
                  "user@example.com"
                ],
                "description": "The email address of the team member. Use this to identify a member by their email."
              },
              "external_id": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "External Id",
                "description": "The external ID of the team member. Use this to identify a member by their external ID."
              },
              "team_member_id": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Team Member Id",
                "examples": [
                  "dbmid:AACzIks68_T0zljJAk8hGSmt0rLx6g5X9p0"
                ],
                "description": "The team member ID. Use this to identify a member by their team member ID."
              }
            },
            "description": "The team member to set the custom quota for. Specify one of team_member_id, email, or external_id.",
            "additionalProperties": false
          },
          "quota_gb": {
            "type": "integer",
            "title": "Quota Gb",
            "minimum": 2,
            "examples": [
              10,
              25,
              50,
              100
            ],
            "description": "The custom quota in GB for the team member. Minimum is 2 GB."
          }
        },
        "description": "Specifies a user and their custom quota."
      },
      "title": "Users And Quotas",
      "maxItems": 1000,
      "minItems": 1,
      "description": "List of users and their custom quotas to set. Maximum of 1000 users per request."
    }
  }
}
```
