## DROPBOX_SHARE_FOLDER
Tool to share a folder with collaborators in Dropbox. Most sharing will be completed synchronously, but large folders will be completed asynchronously. If an async_job_id is returned, you'll need to call check_share_job_status until the action completes to get the folder metadata. Use when you need to create a shared folder or convert an existing folder to a shared folder.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ShareFolderRequest",
  "required": [
    "path"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "path": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Path",
      "examples": [
        "/TestSharedFolder",
        "/Documents/TeamFolder",
        "/Projects/2024/Q1"
      ],
      "description": "The path to the folder to share. If it does not exist, then a new one is created. Must be a valid Dropbox path (e.g., '/TestSharedFolder')."
    },
    "actions": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "FolderAction",
        "required": [
          ".tag"
        ],
        "properties": {
          ".tag": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": ".Tag",
            "description": "The action type (e.g., 'change_options', 'edit_contents', 'invite_editor', 'invite_viewer', etc.)"
          }
        },
        "description": "Actions that may be taken on shared folders."
      },
      "title": "Actions",
      "description": "A list of FolderActions corresponding to FolderPermissions that should appear in the response's SharedFolderMetadata.permissions field describing the actions the authenticated user can perform on the folder."
    },
    "force_async": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Force Async",
      "description": "Whether to force the share to happen asynchronously. Large folders will be completed asynchronously anyway. Set to true to make testing the async case repeatable."
    },
    "link_settings": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "LinkSettings",
      "properties": {
        "expiry": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "LinkExpiry",
          "required": [
            ".tag"
          ],
          "properties": {
            ".tag": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": ".Tag",
              "description": "The expiry action type ('remove_expiry', 'set_expiry', 'other')."
            },
            "set_expiry": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Set Expiry",
              "description": "The expiry timestamp in ISO 8601 format (if tag is 'set_expiry')."
            }
          },
          "description": "Link expiry settings.",
          "additionalProperties": false
        },
        "audience": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "LinkAudience",
          "required": [
            ".tag"
          ],
          "properties": {
            ".tag": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": ".Tag",
              "description": "The audience type. 'public' - Link is accessible by anyone. 'team' - Link is accessible only by team members. 'members' - Link is accessible only by members of the content."
            }
          },
          "description": "The audience type for a link.",
          "additionalProperties": false
        },
        "password": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "LinkPassword",
          "required": [
            ".tag"
          ],
          "properties": {
            ".tag": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": ".Tag",
              "description": "The password action type ('remove_password', 'set_password', 'other')."
            },
            "set_password": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Set Password",
              "description": "The password to set (if tag is 'set_password')."
            }
          },
          "description": "Link password settings.",
          "additionalProperties": false
        },
        "access_level": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "AccessLevel",
          "required": [
            ".tag"
          ],
          "properties": {
            ".tag": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": ".Tag",
              "description": "The access level type. 'viewer' - Can only view. 'viewer_no_comment' - Can only view without comments. 'editor' - Can view and edit."
            }
          },
          "description": "Access level for a collaborator on a shared link.",
          "additionalProperties": false
        }
      },
      "description": "Settings that apply to a link.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "member_policy": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "MemberPolicy",
      "required": [
        ".tag"
      ],
      "properties": {
        ".tag": {
          "enum": [
            "team",
            "anyone",
            "other"
          ],
          "type": "string",
          "title": ".Tag",
          "description": "Who can become a member. 'team' - Only a teammate can become a member. 'anyone' - Anyone can become a member. 'other' - Other."
        }
      },
      "description": "Policy governing who can be a member of a shared folder.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "acl_update_policy": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "AclUpdatePolicy",
      "required": [
        ".tag"
      ],
      "properties": {
        ".tag": {
          "enum": [
            "owner",
            "editors",
            "other"
          ],
          "type": "string",
          "title": ".Tag",
          "description": "Who can add, remove, or change the privileges of members. 'owner' - Only the owner can update the ACL. 'editors' - Any editor can update the ACL. 'other' - Other."
        }
      },
      "description": "Who can change a shared folder's access control list.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "shared_link_policy": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "SharedLinkPolicy",
      "required": [
        ".tag"
      ],
      "properties": {
        ".tag": {
          "enum": [
            "anyone",
            "team",
            "members",
            "other"
          ],
          "type": "string",
          "title": ".Tag",
          "description": "Who can view shared links. 'anyone' - Links can be shared with anyone. 'team' - Links can be shared with anyone on the same team. 'members' - Links can only be shared among members of the shared folder. 'other' - Other."
        }
      },
      "description": "Who can view shared links in this folder.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "viewer_info_policy": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "ViewerInfoPolicy",
      "required": [
        ".tag"
      ],
      "properties": {
        ".tag": {
          "enum": [
            "enabled",
            "disabled",
            "other"
          ],
          "type": "string",
          "title": ".Tag",
          "description": "Whether viewer information is available. 'enabled' - Viewer information is available. 'disabled' - Viewer information is disabled. 'other' - Other."
        }
      },
      "description": "Who can enable/disable viewer info for this shared folder.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for sharing a folder."
}
```

## DROPBOX_START_UPLOAD_SESSION
Tool to start a new upload session with the given data. Use when uploading large files in multiple requests. This call starts the session and you can then use upload_session/append_v2 to add more data and upload_session/finish to complete the upload. A single request should not upload more than 150 MiB.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "StartUploadSessionRequest",
  "properties": {
    "close": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Close",
      "default": false,
      "description": "If true, the current session will be closed after uploading this data, at which point you won't be able to call upload_session/append_v2 anymore with the current session. Set to false to keep the session open for appending more data."
    },
    "content": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "FileUploadable",
      "required": [
        "name",
        "mimetype",
        "s3key"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "name": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Name",
          "examples": [
            "document.pdf",
            "image.jpg",
            "report.docx"
          ],
          "description": "The filename that will be used when uploading the file to the destination service"
        },
        "s3key": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "S3Key",
          "examples": [
            "47563/gmail/GET_ATTACHMENT/response/12345"
          ],
          "description": "The S3 key of a publicly accessible file, typically returned from a previous download action that stored the file in S3. This key references an existing file that can be uploaded to another service."
        },
        "mimetype": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Mimetype",
          "examples": [
            "application/pdf",
            "image/jpeg",
            "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document"
          ],
          "description": "The MIME type of the file"
        }
      },
      "description": "File data to upload in this initial session. Alternatively, you may omit this and use 'local_file_path'.",
      "file_uploadable": true,
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "local_file_path": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Local File Path",
      "examples": [
        "/tmp/data.bin",
        "/abs/path/to/file.dat"
      ],
      "description": "Absolute path to a local file to upload. If provided, the action will read raw bytes from this path instead of the file reference. Useful for testing or when the file is available locally."
    }
  }
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {
    "StartUploadSessionResponse": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "StartUploadSessionResponse",
      "required": [
        "session_id"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "session_id": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Session Id",
          "description": "Unique identifier for the upload session. Use this session_id with upload_session/append_v2 to add more data and upload_session/finish to save the file to Dropbox. Upload sessions are valid for 7 days."
        }
      },
      "description": "Response from starting an upload session."
    }
  },
  "title": "StartUploadSessionResponseWrapper",
  "required": [
    "data",
    "successful"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "data": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Data",
      "required": [
        "session_id"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "session_id": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Session Id",
          "description": "Unique identifier for the upload session. Use this session_id with upload_session/append_v2 to add more data and upload_session/finish to save the file to Dropbox. Upload sessions are valid for 7 days."
        }
      },
      "description": "Data from the action execution"
    },
    "error": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Error",
      "description": "Error if any occurred during the execution of the action"
    },
    "successful": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Successful",
      "description": "Whether or not the action execution was successful or not"
    }
  }
}
```

## DROPBOX_START_UPLOAD_SESSION_BATCH
Tool to start a batch of upload sessions. Use when you need to upload multiple large files and want to initialize multiple upload sessions at once. Each session can then be used with upload_session/append_v2 to upload file chunks and upload_session/finish_batch to complete the uploads.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "StartUploadSessionBatchRequest",
  "required": [
    "num_sessions"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "num_sessions": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Num Sessions",
      "maximum": 1000,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        1,
        5,
        100
      ],
      "description": "The number of upload sessions to start. Must be between 1 and 1000."
    },
    "session_type": {
      "enum": [
        "sequential",
        "concurrent"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Session Type",
      "default": "sequential",
      "examples": [
        "sequential",
        "concurrent"
      ],
      "description": "Type of upload session. 'sequential' means pieces of data are uploaded sequentially one after another (default). 'concurrent' means pieces of data can be uploaded in concurrent RPCs in any order."
    }
  }
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {
    "StartUploadSessionBatchResponse": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "StartUploadSessionBatchResponse",
      "required": [
        "session_ids"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "session_ids": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "title": "Session Ids",
          "description": "List of unique identifiers for the upload sessions. Pass each session_id to upload_session/append_v2 and upload_session/finish_batch endpoints to continue uploading."
        }
      }
    }
  },
  "title": "StartUploadSessionBatchResponseWrapper",
  "required": [
    "data",
    "successful"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "data": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Data",
      "required": [
        "session_ids"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "session_ids": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "title": "Session Ids",
          "description": "List of unique identifiers for the upload sessions. Pass each session_id to upload_session/append_v2 and upload_session/finish_batch endpoints to continue uploading."
        }
      },
      "description": "Data from the action execution"
    },
    "error": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Error",
      "description": "Error if any occurred during the execution of the action"
    },
    "successful": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Successful",
      "description": "Whether or not the action execution was successful or not"
    }
  }
}
```

## DROPBOX_UNLOCK_FILE_BATCH
Tool to unlock multiple files at specified paths in a single batch operation. Locked files can only be unlocked by the lock holder or a team admin (for business accounts). Returns metadata for each unlocked file or error details for failures.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UnlockFileBatchRequest",
  "required": [
    "entries"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "entries": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "LockFileArg",
        "required": [
          "path"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "path": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Path",
            "examples": [
              "/test.txt",
              "/Documents/report.pdf",
              "id:7AObMBUU53AAAAAAAAAARA"
            ],
            "description": "File path (e.g., /test.txt) or file ID (e.g., id:7AObMBUU53AAAAAAAAAARA) to unlock."
          }
        },
        "description": "Argument specifying a file to unlock."
      },
      "title": "Entries",
      "minItems": 1,
      "description": "List of files to unlock. Each entry contains a path or file ID. Duplicate paths are processed only once."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for unlocking multiple files."
}
```

## DROPBOX_UNMOUNT_FOLDER
Tool to unmount a shared folder for the current user. Once unmounted, the shared folder will be removed from the user's Dropbox. Use when a user wants to remove a shared folder from their Dropbox while remaining a member of the folder.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UnmountFolderRequest",
  "required": [
    "shared_folder_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "shared_folder_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Shared Folder Id",
      "examples": [
        "13495912993",
        "84528192421"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the shared folder to unmount."
    }
  }
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {
    "UnmountFolderResponse": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "UnmountFolderResponse",
      "properties": {
        ".tag": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": ".Tag",
          "description": "Error tag if present: 'access_error', 'no_permission', 'not_unmountable', or 'other'"
        },
        "access_error": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "Access Error",
          "required": [
            ".tag"
          ],
          "properties": {
            ".tag": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": ".Tag",
              "description": "Access error type: 'invalid_id', 'not_a_member', 'email_unverified', 'unmounted', or 'other'"
            }
          },
          "description": "There is an error accessing the shared folder"
        }
      }
    },
    "SharedFolderAccessError": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "SharedFolderAccessError",
      "required": [
        ".tag"
      ],
      "properties": {
        ".tag": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": ".Tag",
          "description": "Access error type: 'invalid_id', 'not_a_member', 'email_unverified', 'unmounted', or 'other'"
        }
      }
    }
  },
  "title": "UnmountFolderResponseWrapper",
  "required": [
    "data",
    "successful"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "data": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Data",
      "properties": {
        ".tag": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": ".Tag",
          "description": "Error tag if present: 'access_error', 'no_permission', 'not_unmountable', or 'other'"
        },
        "access_error": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "Access Error",
          "required": [
            ".tag"
          ],
          "properties": {
            ".tag": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": ".Tag",
              "description": "Access error type: 'invalid_id', 'not_a_member', 'email_unverified', 'unmounted', or 'other'"
            }
          },
          "description": "There is an error accessing the shared folder"
        }
      },
      "description": "Data from the action execution"
    },
    "error": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Error",
      "description": "Error if any occurred during the execution of the action"
    },
    "successful": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Successful",
      "description": "Whether or not the action execution was successful or not"
    }
  }
}
```

## DROPBOX_UNSHARE_FILE
Tool to remove all members from a Dropbox file. Use when you need to revoke access for all collaborators on a file. Note: This does not remove inherited members from parent folders and does not support apps with the app folder permission.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UnshareFileRequest",
  "required": [
    "file"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "file": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "File",
      "examples": [
        "id:7bh4zBmgZoAAAAAAAAABJA",
        "/Documents/report.pdf"
      ],
      "description": "The file to unshare. Use the file ID format (e.g., 'id:7bh4zBmgZoAAAAAAAAABJA') or a path to the file. This action removes all members from the file, but does not remove inherited members from parent folders."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for unsharing a file."
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {
    "UnshareFileResponse": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "UnshareFileResponse",
      "properties": {
        "message": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Message",
          "default": "All members successfully removed from the file.",
          "description": "Status message describing the result of the operation."
        },
        "success": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Success",
          "default": true,
          "description": "Indicates whether all members were successfully removed from the file."
        }
      },
      "description": "Response model for unsharing a file."
    }
  },
  "title": "UnshareFileResponseWrapper",
  "required": [
    "data",
    "successful"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "data": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Data",
      "properties": {
        "message": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Message",
          "default": "All members successfully removed from the file.",
          "description": "Status message describing the result of the operation."
        },
        "success": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Success",
          "default": true,
          "description": "Indicates whether all members were successfully removed from the file."
        }
      },
      "description": "Data from the action execution"
    },
    "error": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Error",
      "description": "Error if any occurred during the execution of the action"
    },
    "successful": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Successful",
      "description": "Whether or not the action execution was successful or not"
    }
  }
}
```

## DROPBOX_UNSHARE_FOLDER
Tool to allow a shared folder owner to unshare the folder. Use when you need to stop sharing a folder with all members. Unshare will not work if: the shared folder contains shared folders OR the shared folder is inside another shared folder. You must call check_job_status with the returned async_job_id to determine if the action completed successfully. Requires sharing.write scope.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UnshareFolderRequest",
  "required": [
    "shared_folder_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "leave_a_copy": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Leave A Copy",
      "default": false,
      "description": "If true, members of this shared folder will get a copy of this folder after it's unshared. Otherwise, it will be removed from their Dropbox. The current user, who is an owner, will always retain their copy. Default is false"
    },
    "shared_folder_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Shared Folder Id",
      "examples": [
        "13512984419",
        "84528192421"
      ],
      "description": "The ID for the shared folder to unshare. You can get this from list_shared_folders action"
    }
  }
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {
    "UnshareFolderResponse": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "UnshareFolderResponse",
      "required": [
        "async_job_id"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "async_job_id": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Async Job Id",
          "description": "ID of the asynchronous job. Pass this to check_job_status action to poll the unshare operation status"
        }
      },
      "description": "Response from unshare folder operation.\nContains an async_job_id which should be passed to check_job_status to determine completion."
    }
  },
  "title": "UnshareFolderResponseWrapper",
  "required": [
    "data",
    "successful"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "data": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Data",
      "required": [
        "async_job_id"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "async_job_id": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Async Job Id",
          "description": "ID of the asynchronous job. Pass this to check_job_status action to poll the unshare operation status"
        }
      },
      "description": "Data from the action execution"
    },
    "error": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Error",
      "description": "Error if any occurred during the execution of the action"
    },
    "successful": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Successful",
      "description": "Whether or not the action execution was successful or not"
    }
  }
}
```

## DROPBOX_UPDATE_FILE_MEMBER
Tool to change a member's access level on a shared file. Use when you need to update permissions for an existing file member (e.g., change from editor to viewer or vice versa). Note: This endpoint does not support apps with the app folder permission.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateFileMemberRequest",
  "required": [
    "file",
    "member",
    "access_level"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "file": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "File",
      "examples": [
        "/Documents/report.pdf",
        "id:7bh4zBmgZoAAAAAAAAABCQ"
      ],
      "description": "File for which to update the member's access. Can be a file path (e.g., '/test_read_file_basic.txt') or file ID (e.g., 'id:xxxxx')."
    },
    "member": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Member",
      "required": [
        ".tag"
      ],
      "properties": {
        ".tag": {
          "enum": [
            "email",
            "dropbox_id"
          ],
          "type": "string",
          "title": ".Tag",
          "description": "Type of member selector. 'email' - Identify member by email address. 'dropbox_id' - Identify member by Dropbox account ID."
        },
        "email": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Email",
          "examples": [
            "test@example.com",
            "colleague@company.com"
          ],
          "description": "Email address of the member. Required when tag is 'email'."
        },
        "dropbox_id": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Dropbox Id",
          "examples": [

          ],
          "description": "Dropbox account, team member, or group ID. Required when tag is 'dropbox_id'."
        }
      },

    },

    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for updating a member's access on a file."
}
```

## DROPBOX_UPDATE_FILE_PROPERTIES
Tool to update custom properties on a file or folder in Dropbox. Use when you need to modify metadata fields associated with a property template, such as updating status, priority, or other custom attributes. Requires the files.metadata.write scope.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateFilePropertiesRequest",
  "required": [
    "path",
    "update_property_groups"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "path": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Path",
      "examples": [
        "/Documents/report.pdf",
        "id:a4ayc_80_OEAAAAAAAAAXz"
      ],
      "description": "A unique identifier for the file or folder. Can be a path (e.g., '/test.txt') or file ID (e.g., 'id:a4ayc_80_OEAAAAAAAAAXz')."
    },
    "update_property_groups": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "PropertyGroupUpdate",
        "required": [
          "template_id"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "template_id": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Template Id",
            "examples": [
              "ptid:1a5n2i6d3OYEAAAAAAAAAYa"
            ],
            "description": "A unique identifier for the property template type."
          },
          "remove_fields": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "type": "string"
            },
            "title": "Remove Fields",
            "examples": [
              [
                "old_field",
                "deprecated_field"
              ]
            ],
            "description": "Property field names to remove, provided they exist."
          },
          "add_or_update_fields": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "type": "object",
              "title": "PropertyFieldUpdate",
              "required": [
                "name",
                "value"
              ],
              "properties": {
                "name": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "title": "Name",
                  "examples": [
                    "priority",
                    "status",
                    "category"
                  ],
                  "description": "The name or key of the custom property field."
                },
                "value": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "title": "Value",
                  "examples": [
                    "high",
                    "completed",
                    "urgent"
                  ],
                  "description": "The value to set for this custom property field."
                }
              },
              "description": "A single property field to add or update."
            },
            "title": "Add Or Update Fields",
            "description": "Property fields to add or update. If the property field already exists, it is updated. If it doesn't exist, the property group is added."
          }
        },
        "description": "Represents a property group update with fields to add/update or remove."
      },
      "title": "Update Property Groups",
      "description": "The property groups 'delta' updates to apply. Each update specifies a template ID and the fields to add/update or remove."
    },
    "Dropbox-API-Select-User": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Dropbox Api Select User",
      "examples": [
        "dbmid:AACzIks68_T0zljJAk8hGSmt0rLx6g5X9p0"
      ],
      "description": "Team member ID (format: dbmid:...) required when using team tokens. Specifies which team member's account to operate on."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request to update custom properties on a file or folder."
}
```

## DROPBOX_UPDATE_FILE_REQUEST
Tool to update an existing file request in Dropbox. Use when you need to modify the title, destination, deadline, open/closed status, or description of a file request.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateFileRequestRequest",
  "required": [
    "id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Id",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "The ID of the file request to update. Example: 'oaCAVmEyrqYnkZX9955Y'"
    },
    "open": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Open",
      "description": "Whether to set this file request as open or closed. If true, the file request will accept files. If false, it will be closed."
    },
    "title": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Title",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "The new title of the file request. Must not be empty if provided."
    },
    "deadline": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "FileRequestDeadlineUpdate",
      "properties": {
        "due_date": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Due Date",
          "format": "date-time",
          "description": "The deadline for the file request. Timestamps should be in UTC. Example: '2024-08-15T17:00:00Z'. If not provided, the deadline will be cleared."
        },
        "allow_late_uploads": {
          "enum": [
            "one_day",
            "two_days",
            "seven_days",
            "thirty_days",
            "always"
          ],
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Allow Late Uploads",
          "description": "Specifies the grace period for uploads after the deadline. 'one_day', 'two_days', 'seven_days', or 'thirty_days' allows uploads for that period. 'always' allows indefinite late uploads. If not set, no late uploads are allowed."
        }
      },
      "description": "Represents the deadline parameters when updating a file request deadline.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "description": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Description",
      "description": "The new description of the file request."
    },
    "destination": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Destination",
      "pattern": "^/.*",
      "description": "The new path in the user's Dropbox where uploaded files will be saved. Must be a path starting with '/'. Example: '/Homework/math'"
    }
  },
  "description": "Defines the parameters for updating an existing file request in Dropbox."
}
```

## DROPBOX_UPDATE_FOLDER_MEMBER
Tool to update another member's permissions in a shared folder. Use when an owner or editor needs to change access levels for existing members. This endpoint does not support apps with the app folder permission.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateFolderMemberRequest",
  "required": [
    "shared_folder_id",
    "member",
    "access_level"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "member": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Member",
      "required": [
        ".tag"
      ],
      "properties": {
        ".tag": {
          "enum": [
            "email",
            "dropbox_id"
          ],
          "type": "string",
          "title": ".Tag",
          "description": "Type of member identifier: 'email' for email address, 'dropbox_id' for Dropbox account ID"
        },
        "email": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Email",
          "examples": [
            "user@example.com",
            "colleague@company.com"
          ],
          "description": "Email address of the member. Required when tag is 'email'"
        },
        "dropbox_id": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Dropbox Id",
          "description": "Dropbox account, team member, or group ID of the member. Required when tag is 'dropbox_id'"
        }
      },
      "description": "The member of the shared folder to update. Note: Only the dropbox_id may be used for updates according to API docs, but email is also supported by the endpoint",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "access_level": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Access Level",
      "required": [
        ".tag"
      ],
      "properties": {
        ".tag": {
          "enum": [
            "editor",
            "viewer",
            "viewer_no_comment"
          ],
          "type": "string",
          "title": ".Tag",
          "description": "Access level for the shared folder member: 'editor' - Can edit and manage content, 'viewer' - Can view and comment, 'viewer_no_comment' - Can only view without commenting. Note: 'owner' is not allowed for this endpoint"
        }
      },
      "description": "The new access level for the member. Note: Cannot set access level to 'owner' through this endpoint",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "shared_folder_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Shared Folder Id",
      "examples": [
        "84528192421",
        "13505955667"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the shared folder containing the member to update. You can get this from list_shared_folders action"
    }
  }
}
```

## DROPBOX_UPDATE_GROUP_MEMBER_ACCESS_TYPE
Tool to change a member's access type in a team group. Use when you need to promote a member to owner or demote an owner to regular member. Requires team admin permissions with group management capabilities.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateGroupMemberAccessTypeRequest",
  "required": [
    "group",
    "user",
    "access_type"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "user": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "User",
      "required": [
        ".tag"
      ],
      "properties": {
        ".tag": {
          "enum": [
            "team_member_id",
            "external_id",
            "email"
          ],
          "type": "string",
          "title": ".Tag",
          "description": "Type of user identifier: 'team_member_id' for Dropbox team member ID, 'external_id' for external user ID, 'email' for email address"
        },
        "email": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Email",
          "examples": [
            "user@example.com"
          ],
          "description": "The user's email address. Required when tag is 'email'"
        },
        "external_id": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "External Id",
          "description": "The external user ID. Required when tag is 'external_id'"
        },
        "team_member_id": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Team Member Id",
          "examples": [
            "dbmid:AACwJ2ojytbXGFyiUs6_0Py3GqOt2LyicSg"
          ],
          "description": "The Dropbox team member ID. Required when tag is 'team_member_id'"
        }
      },
      "description": "The user whose access type will be changed. Must be an existing member of the group. Can be identified by team_member_id, external_id, or email",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "group": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Group",
      "required": [
        ".tag"
      ],
      "properties": {
        ".tag": {
          "enum": [
            "group_id",
            "group_external_id"
          ],
          "type": "string",
          "title": ".Tag",
          "description": "Type of group identifier: 'group_id' for Dropbox group ID, 'group_external_id' for external group ID"
        },
        "group_id": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Group Id",
          "examples": [
            "g:e18cdeb8c1e9c0280000000000000057"
          ],
          "description": "The unique Dropbox group ID. Required when tag is 'group_id'"
        },
        "group_external_id": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Group External Id",
          "description": "The external group ID. Required when tag is 'group_external_id'"
        }
      },
      "description": "The group containing the member whose access type will be changed. Specify either by group_id or group_external_id",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "access_type": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Access Type",
      "required": [
        ".tag"
      ],
      "properties": {
        ".tag": {
          "enum": [
            "member",
            "owner"
          ],
          "type": "string",
          "title": ".Tag",
          "description": "Access level for the group member: 'member' for regular member access, 'owner' for owner privileges including ability to manage group"
        }
      },
      "description": "The new access type to assign to the user in the group",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "return_members": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Return Members",
      "default": true,
      "description": "Whether to return the list of members in the group after updating. Note that the default value will cause all group members to be returned, which may take a long time for large groups"
    }
  }
}
```

## DROPBOX_UPDATE_PAPER_DOCUMENT
Tool to update an existing Dropbox Paper document with new content in Markdown, HTML, or plain text format. Use when you need to modify, append, prepend, or overwrite content in an existing Paper doc. This endpoint does not support apps with the app folder permission.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdatePaperDocumentRequest",
  "required": [
    "path",
    "content",
    "import_format",
    "doc_update_policy"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "path": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Path",
      "examples": [
        "/API Test Document.paper",
        "/Meeting Notes.paper",
        "/Documents/Report.paper"
      ],
      "description": "Path to the existing Paper doc in Dropbox to update. MUST include the .paper extension at the end (e.g., '/My Documents/Notes.paper')."
    },
    "content": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Content",
      "examples": [
        "\n\nThis is additional content appended via the update API.",
        "<h2>New Section</h2><p>Updated content here</p>",
        "# New Heading\n\nMarkdown content"
      ],
      "description": "Content to add or replace in the Paper document based on the update policy."
    },
    "import_format": {
      "enum": [
        "plain_text",
        "markdown",
        "html"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Import Format",
      "examples": [
        "plain_text",
        "markdown",
        "html"
      ],
      "description": "Format of the provided content: plain_text, markdown, or html."
    },
    "paper_revision": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Paper Revision",
      "examples": [
        1,
        5,
        10
      ],
      "description": "The paper revision number. Required when doc_update_policy is 'update'. This value must match the current revision of the doc or an error will be returned."
    },
    "doc_update_policy": {
      "enum": [
        "append",
        "prepend",
        "overwrite",
        "update"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Doc Update Policy",
      "examples": [
        "append",
        "prepend",
        "overwrite",
        "update"
      ],
      "description": "Policy for updating the document: 'append' adds content to the end, 'prepend' adds content to the beginning, 'overwrite' replaces all content, 'update' merges content intelligently (requires paper_revision)."
    }
  }
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {

      ],

          "type": "integer",
          "title": "Paper Revision",
          "description": "The revision number of the Paper document after the update."
        }
      }
    }
  },
  "title": "UpdatePaperDocumentResponseWrapper",
  "required": [
    "data",
    "successful"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "data": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Data",
      "required": [
        "paper_revision"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "paper_revision": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "Paper Revision",
          "description": "The revision number of the Paper document after the update."
        }
      },
      "description": "Data from the action execution"
    },
    "error": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Error",
      "description": "Error if any occurred during the execution of the action"
    },
    "successful": {

      "title": "Successful",
```

## DROPBOX_UPDATE_TEAM_FOLDER_SYNC_SETTINGS
Tool to update the sync settings on a team folder or its contents in Dropbox. Use when you need to control whether a team folder or specific content within it is synchronized to members' devices. This is useful for managing storage space and controlling access to sensitive content.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateTeamFolderSyncSettingsRequest",
  "required": [
    "team_folder_id",
    "sync_setting"
  ],
  "properties": {

      "type": "string",
      "title": "Sync Setting",
      "examples": [
        "not_synced",
        "default"
      ],
      "description": "The sync setting to apply to the team folder. Possible values: 'default' (sync normally), 'not_synced' (do not sync)"
    },

      "type": "string",
      "title": "Team Folder Id",
      "examples": [
        "123456789",
        "13739004435"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the team folder to update sync settings for. You can get this from list_team_folders or other team folder operations"
    },
    "content_sync_settings": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "ContentSyncSetting",
        "required": [
          "id",
          "sync_setting"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "id": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Id",
            "examples": [
              "id:a4ayc_80_OEAAAAAAAAAXw",
              "id:bXabc123DEFghiJKLmno"
            ],
            "description": "The ID of the file or folder to configure. Use the Dropbox file/folder ID format (e.g., 'id:a4ayc_80_OEAAAAAAAAAXw')"
          },
          "sync_setting": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Sync Setting",
            "examples": [
              "not_synced",
              "default",
              "not_synced_if_unmounted"
            ],
            "description": "The sync setting to apply to this content. Possible values: 'default' (sync normally), 'not_synced' (do not sync), 'not_synced_if_unmounted' (only sync if folder is mounted)"

        "description": "Sync setting for specific content within a team folder."

      "title": "Content Sync Settings",
      "description": "Optional list of content-specific sync settings within the team folder. Each entry specifies a file or folder ID and its desired sync setting"
```

## DROPBOX_UPDATE_TEAM_MEMBER_ADMIN_PERMISSIONS
Tool to update a team member's admin permissions. Use when you need to grant or revoke admin privileges for team members. Requires team admin permissions to execute.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateTeamMemberAdminPermissionsRequest",
  "required": [
    "user",
    "new_role"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "user": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "User",
      "required": [
        ".tag"
      ],
      "properties": {
        ".tag": {
          "enum": [
            "team_member_id",
            "external_id",
            "email"
          ],
          "type": "string",
          "title": ".Tag",
          "description": "Type of user identifier: 'team_member_id' for team member ID, 'external_id' for external ID, 'email' for email address"
        },
        "email": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Email",
          "examples": [
            "user@example.com",
            "admin@company.com"
          ],
          "description": "Email address of the user. Required when tag is 'email'"
        },
        "external_id": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "External Id",
          "description": "External ID of the user. Required when tag is 'external_id'"
        },
        "team_member_id": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Team Member Id",
          "description": "Team member ID of the user. Required when tag is 'team_member_id'"
        }
      },
      "description": "Identity of the team member whose admin permissions will be set. Use exactly one of team_member_id, email, or external_id to identify the user",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "new_role": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "New Role",
      "required": [
        ".tag"
      ],
      "properties": {
        ".tag": {
          "enum": [
            "team_admin",
            "user_management_admin",
            "support_admin",
            "member_only"
          ],
          "type": "string",
          "title": ".Tag",
          "description": "Admin permissions level for the team member: 'team_admin' - User is an administrator of the team with all permissions, 'user_management_admin' - User can do most user provisioning, de-provisioning and management, 'support_admin' - User can do a limited set of common support tasks for existing users, 'member_only' - User is not an admin of the team"
```

## DROPBOX_UPDATE_TEAM_MEMBER_PROFILE
Tool to update a team member's profile information. Use when you need to change a team member's email, name, external ID, or directory restrictions. At least one profile field must be provided for update.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateTeamMemberProfileRequest",
  "required": [
    "user"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "user": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "User",
      "required": [
        ".tag"
      ],
      "properties": {
        ".tag": {
          "enum": [
            "team_member_id",
            "external_id",
            "email"
          ],
          "type": "string",
          "title": ".Tag",
          "description": "Type of identifier: 'team_member_id' for team member ID, 'external_id' for external ID, or 'email' for email address"
        },
        "email": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Email",
          "examples": [
            "user@example.com"
          ],
          "description": "Email address. Required when tag is 'email'"
        },
        "external_id": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "External Id",
          "description": "External ID. Required when tag is 'external_id'"
        },
        "team_member_id": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Team Member Id",
          "examples": [
            "dbmid:AACzIks68_T0zljJAk8hGSmt0rLx6g5X9p0"
          ],
          "description": "Team member ID. Required when tag is 'team_member_id'"
        }
      },
      "description": "Identity of user whose profile will be set. Exactly one of team_member_id, email, or external_id must be provided to identify the user account",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "new_email": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "New Email",
      "description": "New email for member"
    },
    "new_surname": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "New Surname",
      "description": "New surname for member"
    },
    "new_given_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "New Given Name",
      "description": "New given name for member"
    },
    "new_external_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "New External Id",
      "description": "New external ID for member"
    },
    "new_persistent_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "New Persistent Id",
      "description": "New persistent ID. This field only available to teams using persistent ID SAML configuration"
    },
    "new_is_directory_restricted": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "New Is Directory Restricted",
      "description": "New value for whether the user is a directory restricted user"
    }
  }
}
```

## DROPBOX_UPDATE_TEAM_MEMBER_PROFILE_PHOTO
Tool to update a team member's profile photo. Use when you need to set or change the profile picture of a team member. Requires team admin permissions and a JPEG image (minimum 128x128 pixels) in base64 format.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateTeamMemberProfilePhotoRequest",
  "required": [
    "user",
    "photo"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "user": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "User",
      "required": [
        "team_member_id"
      ],
      "properties": {
        ".tag": {
          "type": "string",
          "const": "team_member_id",
          "title": ".Tag",
          "default": "team_member_id",
          "description": "Type of identifier for the team member. Must be 'team_member_id'."
        },
        "team_member_id": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Team Member Id",
          "examples": [
            "dbmid:AACwJ2ojytbXGFyiUs6_0Py3GqOt2LyicSg",
            "dbmid:efgh5678"
          ],
          "description": "The team member's unique identifier. Can be obtained from team/members/list endpoint."
        }
      },
      "description": "The team member whose profile photo should be updated.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "photo": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Photo",
      "required": [
        "base64_data"
      ],
      "properties": {
        ".tag": {
          "type": "string",
          "const": "base64_data",
          "title": ".Tag",
          "default": "base64_data",
          "description": "Type of photo data. Must be 'base64_data'."
        },
        "base64_data": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Base64 Data",
          "examples": [
            "/9j/4AAQSkZJRgABAQEASABIAAD/2wBDAAEBAQEBAQEBAQEBAQEBAQEBAQEBAQEBAQEBAQEBAQEBAQEBAQEBAQE..."
          ],
          "description": "Base64-encoded JPEG image data. The image must be at least 128x128 pixels. PNG format is not supported."
        }
      },
      "description": "The photo data to be set as the team member's profile photo.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    }
  }
}
```

## DROPBOX_UPLOAD_FILE
Uploads a file (up to ~150 MB) to a specified path in the user's Dropbox, with options for handling existing files. Files larger than 150 MB require a chunked upload approach.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UploadFileRequest",
  "required": [
    "path"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "mode": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Mode",
      "default": "add",
      "examples": [
        "add",
        "overwrite"
      ],
      "description": "Specifies how to handle the upload if a file already exists at the specified path."
    },
    "mute": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Mute",
      "default": false,
      "description": "If true, the user will not be notified of the new file via desktop or mobile notifications."
    },
    "path": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Path",
      "examples": [
        "/Images/photo.jpg",
        "/Documents/file.pdf",
        "/Homework/math/Matrices.txt"
      ],
      "description": "Path in the user's Dropbox to save the file."
    },
    "content": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "FileUploadable",
      "required": [
        "name",
        "mimetype",
        "s3key"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "name": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Name",
          "examples": [
            "document.pdf",
            "image.jpg",
            "report.docx"
          ],
          "description": "The filename that will be used when uploading the file to the destination service"
        },
        "s3key": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "S3Key",
          "examples": [
            "47563/gmail/GET_ATTACHMENT/response/12345"
          ],
          "description": "The S3 key of a publicly accessible file, typically returned from a previous download action that stored the file in S3. This key references an existing file that can be uploaded to another service."
        },
        "mimetype": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Mimetype",
          "examples": [
            "application/pdf",
            "image/jpeg",
            "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document"
          ],
          "description": "The MIME type of the file"
        }
      },
      "description": "File to be uploaded; supports various formats including images, PDFs, and text files. Alternatively, you may omit this and use 'local_file_path'. Must be a valid internal s3key obtained from a trusted upload helper \u2014 raw file bytes, public URLs, or manually constructed keys are not accepted. Ensure the content is the intended file and not an HTML/XML error page from the source server.",
      "file_uploadable": true,
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "autorename": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Autorename",
      "default": false,
      "description": "If true and a file already exists at the path, the new file will be renamed to avoid conflict."
    },
    "local_file_path": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Local File Path",
      "examples": [
        "/abs/path/to/file.pdf",
        "/tmp/screenshot.png"
      ],
      "description": "Absolute path to a local file to upload. Works with files in the local filesystem, including sandbox/workspace files in batch execution (multi_execute)."
    },
    "strict_conflict": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Strict Conflict",
      "default": false,
      "description": "If true, the upload will be rejected if the file already exists, regardless of the autorename setting."
    }
  }
}
```
